title: AI Automation Engineer
text: GAQ427R224 We're hiring an AI Automation Engineer to build the next generation of IT automations to improve the employee experience at Databricks. You'll be building production-grade AI agents and automation services that understand employee requests, retrieve enterprise context, reason across systems, invoke tools and APIs, and take action safely. The goal isn't to automate existing workflows the same way we've done it for the past decade. It's to reimagine how employees interact with IT through intelligent, contextual, and increasingly agentic experiences and to do it on Databricks. What you will do Build AI agents and automations: Design, deploy, and run AI agents that support all of our employees. The agents interpret natural-language requests, gather context, select tools, execute actions, and communicate outcomes. Maintain MCP servers across our AI tools portfolio. Build agentic workflows that decompose goals into steps, handle failures, pause for human approval as needed, and resume their workflows. Ground agents in trusted internal knowledge (policies, runbooks, system documentation, SOPs, etc). Turn high-volume support CUJs into self-service experiences: Identify repetitive, high-friction IT interactions and convert them into reliable AI automation experiences. Instrument AI automations with logs, metrics, and feedback loops. Design and implement AI automations with identity governance, tools RBAC, human-in-the-loop approvals where applicable, audit trails, and failure handling. Create shared automation infrastructure (credential vaults, event ingestion, scheduling, approval workflows, cache/state stores) that other teams can build on. Work with IT Support, Employee Experience, Security, IAM, Infrastructure, and Engineering to identify automation opportunities and take solutions from prototype to production. Write and maintain high-quality technical/engineering documentation that clearly communicates system designs, operational procedures, and architectural decisions. What we are looking for Proficiency in Python or Go [3yrs]. Experience with Git-based development, automated testing, and CI/CD. Strong experience with REST APIs, OAuth2/authentication frameworks, event-driven integrations, and enterprise system integrations. Shipped production LLM-powered applications or AI agents. Experience with agent patterns: tool/function calling, multi-step workflows, context management, RAG, structured outputs, and plan decomposition. Understanding of LLM failure modes: hallucination, incorrect tool use, ambiguous intent, prompt injection, excessive permissions, and non-deterministic behavior. Experience evaluating and improving AI systems using automated evals, traces, test datasets, human feedback, or similar approaches. Ability to translate ambiguous employee friction problems into simple, reliable technical solutions. Strong judgment around security, privacy, least privilege, and safe automation in an enterprise environment. Strong collaboration and communication skills. You will work cross-functionally to plan, design, and implement automation together. Experience with automation or integration platforms (Tines, MuleSoft, Workato, etc.). Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) server development. Nice to have Experience building agents on Databricks (Agent Bricks) or with frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK or LangGraph/LangChain. Experience with MLflow tracing/evaluation, vector search, and LLM observability. Experience integrating IT platforms: Okta/Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Jira, Slack, Jamf, GitHub, Workday, or SaaS administration APIs. title: Analyst Relations Manager
text: MKTQ327R47 Databricks is hiring an Analyst Relations Manager to strengthen its position as the category leader in AI, data management, security, business intelligence and emerging markets. You will lead priority analyst evaluations, create the evidence and narratives that differentiate Databricks, and scale the team’s impact through AI-assisted workflows. Working across product, product marketing, sales and executive teams, you will turn analyst insight into better product decisions, positioning and field execution. The impact you will have Improve Databricks’ placement and movement in priority Gartner Magic Quadrants, Forrester Waves, IDC MarketScapes and similar evaluations through complete, differentiated submissions, compelling demonstrations and credible customer evidence. Increase the team’s evaluation capacity without sacrificing quality by delivering priority questionnaires, RFIs, briefings, demonstrations, references and fact checks on time and in full as evaluation volume grows. Improve the quality and consistency of Databricks’ analyst-facing content by developing clear, scoreable proof points and narratives that product and product marketing experts can reuse across evaluations and briefings. Increase analyst advocacy and market visibility , measured by the frequency with which analysts cite or quote Databricks, reference its experts and customers, and invite the company to participate in relevant industry and analyst-firm events. title: Applied AI Engineer
text: P-1439 As Applied ML/AI Engineer at Databricks, you will define and create the Agentic Machine Learning revolution. You will help world’s largest companies build and deploy massive classical machine learning solutions (such as personalized recommendations, fraud detection, dynamic pricing, forecasting) fully using Databricks’ agents and harnesses. After 30 years of painfully slow progress, expensive knowledge acquisition and tedious processes in classical ML, the agentic era has ushered innovation, scale and visibility for all: from the most junior data scientists and machine learning engineers to the world class experts. You will work on Databricks’ Genie Code, an agent and an ML “exoskeleton” that is authoring ML, training and deploying models, monitoring and self-healing production ML, all at the top-expert level. Additionally, you will develop ML solutions that under the hood address the most pressing questions non-technical business people have today: predictive and what-if questions. Your work is a top priority for Databricks and you will report to a Principal Software Engineer (a Director level position). The impact you will have: Build agentic end-to-end systems in a small, highly international team of experienced engineers in a flat and agile organization. Build solutions for people like you: software engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, data scientists and MLOps engineers. Own our applied ML investment by engaging with engineering and product teams across the company. Drive the development and deployment of state-of-the-art ML/AI models and systems that directly impact the capabilities and performance of Databricks’ products, infrastructure, and services. Architect and implement robust, scalable ML infrastructure, including model training and serving components to support seamless integration of AI/ML models into production environments. Work on novel forecasting techniques. Possibilities to contribute to the broader AI community by presenting at conferences and actively participating in open source projects, enhancing Databricks’ reputation as an industry leader. What we look for: 2-8 years of engineering experience in high-velocity, high-growth companies. Infrastructure and system engineers with no ML background and willingness to excel in personal growth are welcome to apply. Strong software engineering skills, and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing and deployment. Experience developing AI/ML systems at scale in production and a strong track record of ML modeling that goes beyond using standard libraries is a plus. Nice to have: experience deploying, scaling, and monitoring models in production; understanding of the unique infrastructure challenges posed by training and serving predictions in Tier 0 environments. Why Join Us? At Databricks, we are building state-of-the-art AI solutions that redefine how users interact with data and our products. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven products at Databricks, work with cutting-edge models, and collaborate with a world-class team of AI and ML experts. title: Data+AI Workforce Transformation Practitioner — Customer Delivery
text: CSQ327R12 Enterprise customers are investing in AI, but most are stuck between a successful pilot and real organizational adoption. The gap is not technology. It is whether the workforce can change how it works. You will own end-to-end workforce transformation engagements with Databricks' largest customers. You will diagnose where a customer's workforce is today, define what needs to change, build the transformation plan, and drive execution until adoption sticks. You are the directly responsible individual for each engagement, not a contributor to someone else's project. The Impact You Will Have Own the full transformation lifecycle for each customer, from workforce assessment through capability pathways, operating rhythm, and measurement. You build the plan and you execute it. Run 2 to 3 concurrent engagements across different formats. These range from short-cycle assessments (2 to 4 weeks) to coached transformations (8 to 12 weeks) to deep embedded engagements (12 to 16 weeks). You will manage a mixed portfolio simultaneously. Design for multiple organizational layers within a single engagement. That means building executive sponsorship with CDOs, CIOs, and CHROs while also architecting the manager enablement and individual contributor adoption layers underneath. Drive execution, not just planning. You will stand up the operating rhythm, coach internal champions, unblock adoption barriers, and adjust the plan when reality diverges from the model. Design the human-agent collaboration model for each customer's workforce. Assess workflows and distinguish what should stay human from what should be automated, agent-assisted, or fully agent-led. Design differentiated pathways for builders in technical roles and users in workflow roles. Shape how engagements are scoped and priced. You are closest to the work and will ensure that commercial commitments are deliverable. Turn what you learn into repeatable tools and playbooks that can scale beyond practitioner-led delivery. Partner with technical deployment, AI transformation, and account teams. Other teams build and land the solution. You own what happens after. What We Look For 8 or more years leading workforce or organizational transformation in a technology adoption context. You have executed transformations and owned outcomes, not just designed programs. You have led conversations with C-suite or VP-level sponsors and influenced how organizations adopt technology at scale. You have done the work, not just designed a curriculum about it. The strongest backgrounds include customer-side data or engineering leaders who drove transformation, former solutions architects or engineers who moved into transformation roles, and consultants with hands-on delivery experience. You can assess a workflow, identify what needs to change, and design the capability pathway to get there. You understand change management, including sponsorship models, adoption curves, resistance patterns, and how to build internal champions. You are comfortable with ambiguity. You will be building the playbook as you go, not executing a mature one. You are comfortable with commercial conversations, including engagement scoping, pricing input, and ensuring delivery commitments are realistic. Familiarity with data and AI platforms and the enterprise adoption challenges they create. A background in professional services, management consulting, or customer success is a plus. Experience measuring behavior change tied to business value, not just completions or satisfaction scores, is a plus. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability for our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage of Databricks workloads they have already selected, helping them maximize the value they get from our platform and their return on investment. This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel to being technical, with the expectation that you will become the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate effectively with an organization at all levels. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization. The impact you will have: Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritized customers Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live, and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to the production/go-live status of agreed-upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, and Support resources, along with escalating to expert-level technical experts, to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise Create, own, and execute a point of view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews, and upgrade needs Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer-facing technical roles and teams to cover the following work streams: Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production Enablement/user growth plan Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision) Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization) Executive and operational governance Provide internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression - to your Technical GM What we look for: 5+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project/program delivery within the domain of Data and AI, and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers Programming experience in Python, SQL, or Scala Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role Understanding of solution architecture related to distributed data systems Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables Technical program, or project management, including account, stakeholder, and resource management accountability Experience in resolving complex and important escalations with senior customer executives Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis, and managing the delivery of complex programs/projects Track record of overachievement against quota, goals, or similar objective targets Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience Ability to travel up to 30% when needed Pay Range Transparency Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here . Local Pay Range $180,000 — $247,500 USD About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Deployment Strategist
text: About the Team The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform. You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how." Role Description As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption. You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production. This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset. The impact you will have C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline. End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against. Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early. Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution. Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering. What we look for Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions. Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome. Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions. Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting. Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. What You’ll Do C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value ($10M+ problems), and define the pilot (MVP, success criteria, timeline). Agile Project Execution & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team via an agile process, manage all stakeholder communications from the C-suite to individual engineers, and act as the "escalation manager" to unblock all technical or political issues. Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Requirements Executive Presence & Communication: A "Trusted Advisor" with C-suite gravitas and superb communication skills. You are opinionated, humble, and can build rapport and drive decisions in days, not weeks. Product & Strategy Mindset: A "Product Thinker" and "Systems Thinker" who can perform a SWOT analysis, understand a competitive landscape, and define "what" to build and "why." Relentless Execution: An "Execution Driver" with a "Hands-On" mentality. You are relentless, an expert at escalation, and willing to do the unglamorous work to get the project done. Ideal Experience: 2+ years as a Deployment Strategist OR 2+ years at a high-growth startup in a "builder" or "founder" capacity. (Alternatively: 5+ years in a senior, client-facing "product" or "delivery" role at a top-tier tech company or consultancy). Proven Skills: Demonstrated experience in value-based scoping (TCO/ROI), managing agile software projects, writing PRDs, and the ability/interest to travel up to 50%. title: Director, Delivery Solutions Architects - Public Sector
text: CSQ427R326 Please note: Due to federal contract requirements and client-site access obligations, U.S. citizenship is required . Candidates must reside in Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Virginia As Director of Delivery Solution Architects (DSA), Public Sector, you will lead a high-impact post-sales technical organization that helps government customers realize value from the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. Your mission is to ensure that complex Data and AI initiatives—across federal civilian, defense, intelligence, state and local government, education, and public-sector-adjacent organizations—move from concept to production as quickly, securely, and effectively as possible. You will lead DSA managers and a growing team of Delivery Solution Architects responsible for technical strategy, customer outcomes, platform adoption, and usage growth across the Public Sector. You will bridge technical strategy and durable customer value, ensuring teams guide customers through architecture decisions, implementation planning, and scalable operating models for data, analytics, AI, and agentic applications. You will make investment and coverage decisions in collaboration with regional Sales and Field Engineering leaders, shape the value proposition of the DSA function for Public Sector, and build an organization that delivers predictable customer outcomes in a complex, high-growth environment. The Impact You Will Have: Build and lead: Recruit, coach, and scale a diverse, high-performing team of DSAs and managers. Foster a culture of psychological safety, collaboration, and customer obsession. Define, operationalize, and continuously improve the post-sales execution strategy for Databricks’ Public Sector business. Partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, Customer Success, and strategic partners to align account plans, technical success plans, resource investments, and growth strategies. Establish scalable account assignments, customer coverage, prioritization, capacity planning, and resource-allocation practices for strategic Public Sector accounts. Standardize how DSAs guide customers from use-case discovery and architecture through implementation, production go-live, adoption, and platform expansion. Lead a technically excellent DSA organization with deep expertise in cloud data platforms, data engineering, warehousing, ETL/ELT, streaming, governance, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic applications. Ensure customers receive practical, secure, scalable architectural guidance for production data products, analytics platforms, AI applications, and mission-critical workloads. Apply Public Sector-specific requirements—including security, compliance, governance, mission continuity, procurement, and complex stakeholder environments—to architecture and delivery decisions. Serve as a trusted executive technical advisor for select strategic customers, linking technical roadmaps and modernization programs to agency missions and measurable outcomes. Build strong executive and operational relationships across customer technical, program, procurement, operational, and leadership stakeholders to accelerate adoption and long-term value. Create operating mechanisms, playbooks, metrics, and review cadences to monitor customer health, delivery progress, adoption, usage growth, risks, escalations, and forecasted expansion. Drive cross-functional resolution of delivery blockers and escalations, while providing leadership feedback on field processes, product needs, programs, and organizational investments. What We Look For: 7+ years of customer-facing experience in technical delivery, architecture, consulting, customer success, professional services, or post-sales leadership roles. 5+ years of people-leadership experience, proven ability to recruit, coach, develop, and build career paths for high-performing technical talent, including success leading managers and scaling multi-level technical organizations. Experience building and leading post-sales, delivery, customer success, architecture, consulting, or professional-services organizations. Deep expertise in cloud data and AI technologies, including data engineering, data warehousing, analytics, ETL/ELT, data governance, machine learning, data science, and AI. Demonstrated success delivering production-grade data products, analytics platforms, AI solutions, and other scalable, secure, and governable customer workloads. Ability to lead teams through architecture decisions, technical success planning, delivery execution, production go-lives, and customer-growth strategies. Deep understanding of Public Sector and regulated customer environments, including mission priorities, complex stakeholder models, governance requirements, and long planning cycles. Executive presence and business acumen to engage senior leaders, manage strategic accounts, and make portfolio-level resource, investment, coverage, and prioritization decisions. Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across Sales, pre-sales, Professional Services, Customer Success, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and external partners to resolve escalations, mitigate risk, remove blockers, and improve customer outcomes. Additional Requirements: U.S. citizenship is required due to Public Sector client-support requirements. Willingness to travel up to 30%, primarily within the Washington, D.C. metro area and to customer locations as needed. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. title: Director of Engineering - Databricks Commercialization & Marketplace
text: Director of Engineering - Databricks Commercialization & Marketplace P-1630 About the role Every product Databricks ships has to be priced, contracted, rated and billed before it can earn a dollar. The Money organization builds the systems that make this happen, at hyperscaler scale and across every major cloud. We built the world's only cross-cloud integrated rating engine in-house, and it now rates billions of dollars in revenue. Our next goal is bigger: a fully automated, zero-touch order-to-cash flow where the platform is the source of truth for accounts, contracts and subscriptions, and Month End Close needs little or no human intervention. As Director of Engineering, you will lead the engineering organization that owns this commercial engine from start to finish. You will set the product and technology strategy for how Databricks makes money. You will be the engineering voice Finance, Product and GTM leaders turn to for strategic decisions. You will also build the leadership bench that lets the organization keep scaling. Speed is critical. Databricks keeps inventing new ways to sell: commit and pay-as-you-go, marketplaces, conditional benefits, strategic partnerships and new clouds and regions. The commerce engine either makes each of these fast and safe to launch, or it becomes the bottleneck. You will make sure it is the former. What you'll own The org covers six commercial domains: Pricing configuration: SKUs, multipliers, price-change processes, deal desk and discounting Orders and contracts: from negotiated quote to order to signed customer contract Subscriptions: commit, pay-as-you-go and proof-of-concept subscriptions, plus how contracts are tied to payment methods Rating: applying each customer's negotiated price, discounts and conditional benefits to ingested usage to compute the bill Billing: commit drawdown, invoicing, Month End Close and related financial processes Marketplace: third-party data and solutions, available seamlessly to Databricks customers The impact you'll have Set and communicate the vision. Write the multi-year product and technology strategy for the commerce engine, toward a zero-touch order-to-cash flow and a next-generation billing architecture. Present it clearly to executives, Finance and Product leaders, so that strategy and architecture decisions come to you by default. Own business outcomes across orgs, not just your team's part. Revenue-critical programs routinely span 100+ people across Finance, Product, IT, Accounts and GTM. You will own the full outcome: dependency plans with clear owners, timelines, quality bars and escalation triggers, raised early in leadership forums so cross-org risks don't become executive surprises. Make commercialization a platform capability. Build reusable building blocks (credits, commits, conditional benefits, marketplace and partner billing) so that new pricing models and routes to market ship in weeks, not quarters. Treat foundations as seriously as features. Hold reliability, correctness, SOX and compliance readiness, security, cost visibility and operational load to the same standard as product launches. Billing errors should be structurally impossible, operational work should grow more slowly than revenue, and postmortems should actually lead to change. Partner deeply with Business & Finance. Turn accounting, close and compliance requirements into engineering design. Keep improving the Month End Close timeline and audit readiness, and earn the trust of Technical Accounting, Revenue Ops and Strategy & Execution leaders. Build a team of leaders. Grow the organization from one with a large group of direct-report engineers to one led by strong engineering managers and tech-lead managers, with clear subteams, domain boundaries and named owners. Coach managers to be great people leaders, give specific feedback and career plans, and recognize high-performing teams publicly. Hire like a founder. Act as the hiring owner for the Money Bellevue site. Source and close senior engineering and management talent, put the company first when placing hires across Money teams, and help raise the Databricks engineering hiring bar. What we're looking for 12+ years in software engineering, including 6+ years leading engineering organizations and managing managers, ideally in billing, payments, commerce, fintech or other systems where errors directly cost revenue or create regulatory exposure A track record of delivering large, revenue-critical, cross-functional programs (for example, replacing a billing or rating system, migrating a source of truth, or automating order-to-cash) on time and with high quality Technical depth in distributed systems and large-scale data pipelines. You can discuss correctness, idempotency, reconciliation and data lineage with tech leads, and you know when to coach and when to decide. Fluency in order-to-cash and finance concepts: pricing and discounting, contracts, revenue recognition, invoicing, month-end close, SOX controls. You have earned trust as a partner to Finance and Accounting leaders. Strong product judgment: you can spot gaps in the commercial platform, shape requirements with Product, and make build-versus-buy decisions that pay off over time Clear, confident communication of strategy to executives, plus the ability to influence peers in Product, Finance, IT and GTM without direct authority Experience scaling an organization quickly while keeping a high hiring bar, developing strong leaders and engineers, and keeping them engaged on internal platform work BS in Computer Science or a related field; MS preferred. Experience with Kafka, Apache Spark, Delta Lake or cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus. Why this role You will run the engine behind the revenue of one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world. The problems involve hard distributed-systems correctness at scale, high financial and compliance stakes, and a direct, visible link to company growth. title: Director of Engineering (Data Infrastructure)
text: (P-1490) Databricks processes petabytes of data and billions of transaction events daily - every cluster launch, every query executed, every dollar billed flows through infrastructure that must never fail. When we process billions in billing transactions with 99.999% accuracy requirements, when we ingest terabytes per second across 100+ regions, when a five-minute outage costs millions in revenue and customer trust - infrastructure isn't just important, it's existential. The next phase of our growth demands disaster recovery systems that prove reliability rather than hope for it, testing frameworks that catch production-scale problems before deployment, correctness guarantees that make billing errors structurally impossible, and automation that scales operations sublinearly with growth. In this leadership opportunity, you will build the data infrastructure organization that makes Databricks' continued growth possible. You'll establish foundational teams in Bengaluru owning the bedrock systems that guarantee billing correctness, operational resilience, and zero-downtime recovery across our entire monetization stack, alongside multi-region data ingestion, developer platforms, and deployment automation that eliminate friction at petabyte scale. This isn't about maintaining what exists; it's about architecting the infrastructure that enables Databricks to scale while reducing operational burden. You'll define what world-class infrastructure looks like for the next decade of data platforms. You will pursue these challenges as a founding technical leader in our fastest-growing engineering hub and strategic partner to global infrastructure leaders. In addition to building world-class teams, you will shape architectural decisions that ripple across the company and champion infrastructure-as-product thinking that transforms infrastructure into force multipliers globally. You'll work in an engineering culture born from Apache Spark and open source, where technical depth matters and infrastructure engineers are celebrated as craftspeople. The perfect candidate has built infrastructure organizations at companies where five nines weren't simply aspirational, where petabyte-scale wasn't marketing but Monday, and where the infrastructure team's technical leverage determined whether the business could scale or stall. You have the technical depth to debate data architecture, the strategic vision to define multi-year platform roadmaps, the leadership craft to build teams that top engineers want to join, and most importantly, the conviction that data infrastructure done right doesn't just support the business; it defines what's possible. The impact you’ll have: Deliver the infrastructure vision for systems processing billions in daily billing transactions with zero tolerance for error, building disaster recovery that's provably reliable, testing frameworks that catch what production sees, correctness systems that make billing errors structurally impossible, and observability that predicts failures before they happen Build Bengaluru's data infrastructure organization by establishing it as the destination for India's top infrastructure talent , hiring multiple engineering managers who become force multipliers, and creating a culture where solving hard distributed systems problems at scale is the daily work Own business-critical systems operating 24/7/365 across 100+ regions where even 99.9% uptime means hours of customer pain, driving reliability improvements that prevent millions in revenue loss while eliminating operational toil through frameworks that make systems self-healing, self-tuning, and self-documenting Ship platforms that compound engineering leverage across Databricks: correctness frameworks that catch billing errors before customers do, deployment automation that makes regional expansion push-button, data integration systems that process petabyte-scale flows without human intervention, and testing infrastructure where comprehensive coverage is automatic, not heroic Position infrastructure as product by treating internal engineering teams as customers with SLAs, measuring adoption and satisfaction, iterating based on feedback, and demonstrating that every dollar invested in infrastructure returns multiplicative gains in product velocity, reliability improvements, or cost reductions What you’ll need: 14+ years in distributed systems engineering with 6+ years leading infrastructure organizations and 4+ years managing managers at companies where infrastructure failures meant immediate revenue impact, customer escalations, or regulatory consequences - and you built the systems and teams that made those failures rare Technical depth across petabyte-scale data pipelines and distributed systems reliability where you can engage from "how should we architect multi-region disaster recovery" to "why is this Kafka cluster exhibiting this latency pattern" while knowing when to coach versus when to decide Track record defining multi-year infrastructure vision and translating it into sequential deliverables that show value quarterly while building toward architectural end states, positioning infrastructure investments as business enablers rather than cost centers, and making build-vs-buy decisions that compound over time Experience building 99.999%+ reliable systems with established practices for SLOs/SLIs, chaos engineering, disaster recovery, and sophisticated observability that predicts failures before they happen Proven ability to scale infrastructure organizations in high-growth environments where you've doubled engineering while maintaining quality bar, developed engineering managers, and created teams where retention is high because the problems are interesting and the culture is strong Communication skills to make complex infrastructure decisions legible to executives (translating technical investments into business outcomes), influence cross-functional partners without authority, build trust across global teams in different timezones with different working styles, and represent Databricks' technical brand externally BS in Computer Science or Engineering; MS or Ph.D. preferred. title: Director, Order to Revenue Compliance
location: Central - United States; West Coast - United States
text: GAQ227R127 Databricks is seeking an experienced, highly strategic leader to serve as Director of Order to Revenue Compliance. As Databricks continues to scale, protecting our usage-based revenue engine requires dedicated fiduciary oversight at the intersection of product metering, billing systems, and financial accounting. In this key player/coach leadership role, you will lead a specialized team bridging the gap between raw product metering and financial ground truth. You will oversee usage execution, establish product launch controls, direct partner royalty reconciliations, oversee compliance with partnership arrangements, and serve as the primary compliance lead for usage-related SOX controls and audits. Primary Responsibilities Strategic Team Leadership : Lead, coach, and scale a high-performing team consisting of two functional leads covering Partnerships / Royalty, Money/Engineering Compliance, and Issue Resolution. Actively uphold our culture principles and leadership essentials in daily execution. Usage & Revenue Fiduciary Oversight : Serve as the primary business and compliance oversight body responsible for ensuring all usage-related, financially impacting processes are accurate, complete, SOX-compliant, and validated prior to customer billing and revenue conversion. Partner Agreement & Royalty Governance : Assume complete ownership of outbound/inbound royalty reporting, executions, and complex reconciliations (e.g., Azure/Microsoft, AWS, GCP, SAP). Eliminate manual operational risks, ingestion lag, timing mismatches, and contract-period attribution issues. Cross-Functional System Controls & "Two-in-the-Box" Execution : Partner closely with Engineering (Money Team) and Finance Data Systems (FDS) prior to product launches to validate metering, pricing models, SKU additions, and billing logic against business intent. Audit Ownership & Technical Accounting : Act as the primary audit lead for external audit, internal audit, and executive stakeholders regarding platform consumption calculations and monetization structures. Remediation & Root Cause Analysis (RCA) : Oversee the categorization and resolution of usage issues (Types 1–3), standardize refund SLAs/credits, and drive mandatory cross-functional RCAs with Engineering to prevent systemic metering bugs. Minimum Qualifications Education & Certification : Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related technical field; CPA license preferred. Experience : 12+ years of relevant experience, including extensive experience in revenue accounting, IT audit, and SOX control frameworks. Domain Expertise : Familiarity with ASC 606, specifically applied to consumption-based/usage-based revenue models, SaaS, and complex partner royalty agreements. Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence : Proven track record of managing managers or functional leads while directly collaborating with executive leadership across Engineering, Sales Operations, FP&A, and external auditors. Technical & Analytical Acumen : Ability to bridge technical systems (product metering engines, SQL/data pipelines, sub-ledgers) with accounting rules and complex contract terms. text: MKTQ225R87 Databricks is seeking a Director, Paid Media to lead our global media planning function and define how paid media supports brand awareness, demand generation, and pipeline growth across the full funnel. You will lead a team of global media planners to develop audience-first, account-focused strategies that engage both technical practitioners and executive decision-makers across priority accounts. This highly cross-functional role partners closely with Corporate Brand, Product Marketing, Integrated Campaigns, Field Marketing, Analytics, and external agencies to deliver cohesive, data-driven media strategies at scale. The impact you will have: Guide the development of cross-channel media strategies that deliver measurable year-over-year increases in brand awareness, target account engagement, and pipeline contribution across integrated campaigns and priority product areas. text: GAQ427R220 Mission Databricks is seeking a senior finance leader based in Ireland to fulfill a dual-impact role: leading our global technical Revenue Assurance function supporting EMEA/APAC regions and serving as the foundational Country Lead for the newly established Databricks Ireland entity. This high-visibility role combines strategic technical accounting with operational leadership. You will manage a global revenue assurance team while personally establishing and executing key operational processes for Databricks in Ireland. You will serve as the core on-the-ground finance lead supporting intercompany execution, local contract fulfillment, and revenue assurance oversight to ensure seamless business operations across Ireland and the European Union. Contract & Order Oversight: Support local contract execution workflows on behalf of the entity, ensuring all EU customer order forms and cloud services agreements adhere to established commercial and legal guardrails. Experience applying differences in IFRS 15 vs. ASC 606 in local statutory accounting. Deal Strategy & Commercial Advisory: Partner with Global Sales, Strategic Pricing, Deal Desk, and Legal functions during deal negotiations to structure non-standard, complex customer contracts in compliance with revenue recognition standards. Delegated Approval Authority: Exercise tiered finance approval authority for non-standard pricing and commercial terms within established guardrails. Cross-Functional Process Innovation: Collaborate with FP&A, IT, RevOps, and Order-to-Cash teams to identify data, process, and automation improvements (e.g., system enhancements, SQL data analysis) to minimize manual workarounds and scale operations. title: Director, Technical Marketing
text: MKTQ427R50 As the Director of Technical Marketing at Databricks, you will lead and scale the team responsible for explaining Databricks products, and what you can do with them, at scale to technical buyers and practitioners (from data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to solutions architects, platform teams, security engineers, and application developers). You will own the strategy and execution of technical content in written and video form, demos, workshops, launch storytelling, and outbound evangelism that drives technical mindshare, consideration, product adoption, and ultimately pipeline. In the era of agentic marketing and AEO/GEO, your team will increasingly produce content designed to educate both humans and agents alike. You will also play an outsized role in programming the technical content for key Databricks events, such as the Data + AI Summit and Data + AI World Tour, among others. Reporting to the SVP of Product & Solutions Marketing, you will manage a team of 6+ Technical Marketing Managers (growing) and serve as the connective tissue between Product, Product Marketing, Field Engineering, and the broader technical community. This role expands the traditional TMM charter to include a stronger outbound evangelism dimension, becoming a visible, trusted technical voice externally through social media, YouTube, conferences, and the data practitioner ecosystem while continuing to own the core technical content engine that powers Summit, World Tour, workshops, and field enablement. The impact you will have: First 6 months: Assess the current TMM team's strengths, gaps, and capacity; establish a clear operating model with defined ownership areas (product coverage, content types, GEO) and a quarterly planning cadence. Own and deliver the technical content agenda for Data + AI World Tour and/or the next major Tier 1 event, achieving ≥4.5/5.0 average session ratings and measurable pipeline contribution. Launch or significantly expand at least 2 new outbound evangelism motions (e.g., a YouTube series architecture, a technical social media cadence, or a creator/influencer engagement program) that grow Databricks' external technical reach by ≥25%. Build an AI-powered publishing engine that enables the TMM team to scale content faster, leveraging AI assistance for content creation and publishing. Establish yourself as a credible external technical voice, publishing 3+ original technical pieces (blogs, videos, or talks) and representing Databricks at 2+ external events or podcasts. First 12 months: Scale the TMM team to meet growing demand across an expanding set of technical personas (solutions architects, platform engineers, security teams, data scientists, analysts, app developers) driven by the 2026+ product surface (Lakebase, Genie, Lakewatch, Agent Bricks, Omnigent). Work with Databricks Field Engineering and FDE (Forward-Deployed Engineering) to capture repeatable product use cases into a Solutions Library, building a motion to scale capture and marketing of these use cases for learning across the entire community. Build and operationalize a "1 launch → many assets" content engine that converts every major product launch into persona-specific learning journeys (demos, workshops, blogs, videos, social). Grow Databricks' YouTube and social technical content reach by 2x, with a series-based content architecture targeting key personas at multiple depth levels. Drive measurable contribution to AEO/GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) ensuring Databricks is cited by default in AI answer engines for key buyer questions. First 18–24 months: Establish Databricks as the default place every technical practitioner learns data + AI, measured by YouTube subscriber growth (target: 300K+), technical content engagement, and Free Edition activation rates tied to content. Build a formal Databricks Creators program that turns independent creator reach into co-owned, accurate, early-access content across new product areas. Develop the TMM team into a recognized center of excellence — with clear career paths, a strong hiring bar, and a reputation as one of the best technical marketing teams in enterprise software. What we look for: 10+ years of experience in technical marketing, developer relations, solutions engineering, field engineering, or a related technical field in enterprise software / SaaS / cloud. 3+ years of people management experience, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams. Deep technical fluency in data, AI/ML, and cloud platforms, comfortable building demos and engaging credibly with data engineers, data scientists, solutions architects, and other technical practitioners across the data + AI ecosystem. Demonstrated outbound evangelism skills, including a visible external presence through conference speaking, technical blogging, YouTube/video content, or social media thought leadership. Experience owning technical content strategy for major product launches and flagship events (e.g., user conferences, world tours). Strong cross-functional influence with a proven ability to partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, Field Engineering, and Sales to align on priorities and deliver integrated GTM. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for multiple audiences. Preferred: Experience with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, Apache Spark, or related open-source data technologies. Experience building or scaling a YouTube channel, podcast, or technical content program for practitioner audiences. Familiarity with GEO / AI answer engine optimization strategies. title: Director, Travel & Expense
text: GAQ327R263 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered. We are seeking a strategic, operationally strong Director, Travel & Expense to lead and modernize our global travel, expense, and corporate spend ecosystem. This leader will drive a digital-first, highly scalable program that improves the employee experience while strengthening governance, compliance, and financial discipline across a fast-growing global organization. This role is ideal for a builder who can define future-state strategy while also leading hands-on execution, operational rigor, and measurable outcomes. The successful candidate will partner closely across Finance, Procurement, IT, HR, Security, and Operations to create a seamless and future-ready T&E model. The impact you will have: Lead the transformation of the T&E program into a modern, automated, digital-first experience, including AI-enabled workflows, touchless expense processing, automated audit controls, and intelligent policy enforcement. Create a frictionless employee experience across booking, expense submission, approvals, reimbursements, and support while simplifying processes and reducing manual work. Build a scalable global T&E roadmap that balances agility, governance, employee experience, and operational efficiency, with clear KPIs, dashboards, and change management to support adoption. Oversee global business travel operations across air, hotel, ground transportation, meetings, and traveler support, while shaping regional travel strategies for a distributed workforce. Manage travel partners and supplier relationships to improve service levels, optimize spend, and support evolving business needs. Partner with Security and HR to strengthen traveler safety, duty of care, and crisis response capabilities. Lead enterprise expense reimbursement and corporate card programs with a focus on automation, compliance, scalability, and employee experience. Implement intelligent expense capabilities such as auto-generated reports, AI auditing, receipt automation, and policy-driven workflows, while simplifying approvals and accelerating reimbursement cycles. Partner closely with AP, Payroll, and Finance Operations to streamline end-to-end financial processes. Own the T&E technology ecosystem, including platforms such as Emburse, Egencia, Ramp, Brex, AppZen, and corporate card integrations; partner with IT and Finance Systems on integrations, APIs, and analytics. Ensure strong policy governance, financial controls, audit readiness, and compliance with global tax, regulatory, data privacy, and regional travel requirements. Build and lead a high-performing global team, develop leadership bench strength, and influence cross-functional stakeholders in a complex, fast-moving environment. What we look for: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Supply Chain, Hospitality, Information Systems, or a related field. 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Travel, Expense, Procurement, Finance Operations, Shared Services, or related functions. Proven success leading T&E transformation, automation, or digital modernization initiatives in high-growth or fast-paced organizations. Experience leading global or multinational T&E programs and managing regional operations and cross-border transformation efforts. Strong operational leadership with the ability to translate strategy into scalable execution. Deep expertise in T&E platforms, workflow automation, corporate card programs, and expense technologies. Strong understanding of AI-enabled operations, process redesign, and scalable service delivery models. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and change leadership skills, with the ability to lead through ambiguity and evolving business priorities. Experience leading global or multinational T&E programs. MBA, CPA, CTP, or related certification preferred. Lean Six Sigma, automation, or digital transformation experience strongly preferred. title: Director, Web Marketing
text: MKTQ327R30 Databricks is hiring an experienced web leader to grow and scale the function globally, as the company continues its hyper-growth and leadership in the Data and AI space. You will be an essential member of the marketing leadership team, drawing on all of our internal resources to bring our marketing strategy to our digital audiences — and increasingly to a new kind of audience: the AI agents and assistants that now read, interpret, and act on the web on behalf of the people we're trying to reach. You will ultimately be measured on your ability to develop a cohesive portfolio of web properties built for scale, personalization, and this next era of how people and machines discover and evaluate companies. Reporting to the VP of Marketing, you will build and oversee a product team focused on executing and iterating on marketing priorities. The ideal candidate has held a senior digital leadership role in a high-performing marketing organization at a company experiencing rapid growth. You have operated at scale in a global environment while maintaining a solution-oriented mindset and approach. You have excellent fundamentals, strong presence, and the ability to build a strong team. Just as important, you have a point of view on where the web is going, and know how to build for AI-driven search, answer engines, and autonomous agents. The impact you will have: Transform Databricks' web properties into outstanding destinations using a modern development approach and current technologies, built to serve both human visitors and the AI agents and assistants that now consume and act on web content. Put AI to work inside the function, using it to automate and accelerate web production, QA, localization, testing, and routine optimization so the team spends its time on strategy and craft rather than repetitive execution. Establish a strategy for how Databricks evolves and scales its web presence with the business across segments, products, industries, partners, and languages — and for how our content stays legible, accurate, and well-represented as AI systems increasingly mediate discovery. Monitor and optimize web traffic and coordinate with global teams to ensure the success of both worldwide brand awareness and demand generation efforts in every market. Implement a robust testing and personalization program using all available tools to create creative, tailored digital experiences that increase conversion. Ensure our web properties are structured for machine readability — clean information architecture, structured data, and content that both people and agents can parse and trust — so Databricks is accurately represented wherever our audiences are researching. Leverage data on product usage and website analytics, working directly with the broader marketing team to develop strategies that improve growth. Manage internal and external partners and vendors, and serve as the in-house expert for web strategy across the organization. Strengthen the cross-departmental collaboration required to support and develop digital experiences for all of our audiences, through established processes and frameworks for high-velocity execution. Build and lead a growing, globally distributed team, ensuring both team and personal growth. What we look for: 10+ years on a high-performing web marketing or development team. 5+ years managing a team. Depth in the technical aspects of running a website: analytics, UX, technical and content SEO, and information architecture. A point of view on the future of the web — AI-driven search and answer engines, structured/machine-readable content, and designing for AI agents and assistants as a genuine audience, not a novelty. A track record of adopting AI tools and agents to streamline web workflows. Experience growing and scaling a function to meet the needs of team members, other departments, and contractors. A strategic partner and agreement builder who helps other teams translate requirements into customer-centric web experiences. Have led a large-scale, international website refresh or rebuild. Experience with web optimization and testing frameworks, and ideally with modern composable/headless architectures. text: SLSQ427R94 As an Enterprise Account Executive - Hunter, your primary mission will be to identify, acquire, and grow new business opportunities across multiple industries. This role is focused on securing new logos and driving revenue growth by targeting Enterprise accounts in diverse sectors. You are a proactive "hunter" who thrives on building relationships, navigating complex sales cycles, and closing high-value deals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver tailored solutions that address client needs and establish long-term partnerships. You will report to the Director, Sales in Japan. The impact you will have: Secure new Enterprise accounts across multiple industries, creating a strong foundation for long-term partnerships. Develop and execute a focused strategy for identifying and winning high-potential accounts in untapped markets. Identify and close quick wins while managing longer, complex sales cycles. Plan, document, and drive the growth of Databricks usage in newly won accounts to maximize customer impact. Establish essential C-Level relationships, including Engineering, Platform, Architecture, and Data Science roles, who will, in turn, be your industry advocates. Use a solution-based approach to selling and creating value for customers. Develop a deep and detailed understanding of the customer's business. Provide leadership to the customer, important staff, and technical teams. Identify all important data use cases and buying centers in an opportunity, to increase the impact of Databricks in an organization. Orchestrate and use Databricks teams and ecosystem partners to maximize your impact on your sales motions. What we look for: 5+ years of experience selling multi-million dollar complex software deals to the region's recognizable organizations within the Enterprise segment. Knowledge of segment priorities, buying processes, buying cycles, decision-making process, and the ecosystem Background in selling usage-based PaaS/ SaaS solutions, or other Data/ AI/ML technologies. 5+ years of experience in sales methodologies and processes, e.g. account planning, MEDDPICC, value selling, and Command of the Message. 5+ years of experience in hunting in a greenfield space while also consulting with existing accounts to expand further use. Build customer champions and collaborative teams to support the implementation of the expansion plan. Understanding of how to develop a clear partner strategy and manage it successfully. Enterprise Account Executive - Hunterとして、あなたは主なミッションは複数の業界に属する顧客において新しいビジネスチャンスを特定し、獲得し、成長させることです。このロールは新規顧客を獲得し、エンタープライズ顧客におけるターゲットの売上拡大を促進することに重点を置いています。 あなたは、お客様とのリレーションを構築し、複雑な販売サイクルの中で大規模な取引を成立させることに成功する、積極的な「ハンター」です。部門横断のチームと緊密に連携し、お客様のニーズに対応したソリューションを提供し、長期的なパートナーシップを確立していただきます。日本の Sales Director 配下となります。 期待されるインパクト： 複数の業界にわたる顧客を獲得し、長期的なパートナーシップのための強力な基盤を構築する。 未開拓の市場で潜在力の高い顧客を特定し、獲得するための焦点を絞った戦略を開発および実行する。 複雑かつ長期の販売サイクルをコントロールし、早期の案件を発掘し獲得する。 新規に獲得した顧客におけるビジネス効果を最大化するため、Databricksの利用拡大を計画、推進する。 エンジニアリング、プラットフォーム、アーキテクチャ、データ サイエンスの役割を含む重要な経営幹部レベルの関係を確立し、業界のアドボケイトとなる。 ソリューションアプローチにより販売し、顧客価値を創出する。 顧客のビジネスを深く詳細に理解する。 顧客、組織、技術チームに対してリーダーシップを発揮する。 顧客の組織内でのDatabricksのインパクトを高めるために、案件における全ての重要なデータのユースケースと利用部門を特定する。 Databricksチームとエコシステムパートナーを連携し、ビジネスへのインパクトを最大化する。 求める人材: エンタープライズの著名な組織に数億円規模の複雑なソフトウェア取引を販売した 5 年以上の経験。 優先セグメント、購入プロセス、購入サイクル、意思決定プロセス、エコシステムに関する知識。 従量制の PaaS/SaaS ソリューション、またはその他のデータ/AI/ML テクノロジーを販売した経験。 営業メソッドおよびプロセスにおける 5 年以上の経験。 例）アカウントプランニング、MEDDPICC、バリューセリング、Command of the Message。 未開拓市場のハンター営業およびさらなる利用拡大のための既存顧客へのコンサルティングにおける 5 年以上の経験。 拡大計画の実行をサポートする顧客のチャンピオンと協同チームの発掘。 明確なパートナー戦略の策定とそれを成功に導く方法に関する理解。 About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. title: Field Enablement Manager, Emerging Business & LATAM
text: FEQ427R368 The Emerging Business & LATAM Field Enablement Manager builds the enablement strategy that helps Databricks win new customers, move faster in high-volume territories, and grow platform consumption across the Emerging Business and Latin America segments. Much of this field is early in their careers and sells in a high-velocity motion across large books of accounts. The role partners with Sales and Field Engineering leadership to turn segment priorities into measurable gains in seller skills, ramp time, pipeline, and consumption. The Impact You Will Have In the first 12–18 months, build a prioritized enablement roadmap for approximately 500 account executives and field engineers across Emerging Business and LATAM. You'll review progress and business impact in regular leadership business reviews. Help new sellers ramp faster with repeatable onboarding and foundational skills programs covering prospecting, discovery, qualification, pipeline management, deal progression, and technical proficiency. Adapt global and AMER enablement for LATAM's markets, languages, and buyers. Partner with the Scale Motion Lead and Global Enablement to apply shared playbooks to the segment, and build a measurable feedback loop that turns recurring field needs into prioritized programs and scales what works. What We Look For 6+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, field enablement, sales, or technical pre-sales in the technology sector, including experience supporting both commercial and technical audiences. Demonstrated experience enabling early-in-career sellers (for example SDRs, BDRs, or new AEs or Solution Architects) and building foundational sales skills programs that measurably change seller behavior. Experience supporting high-velocity, high-volume sales motions, where you design for leverage, repeatability, and self-serve before live delivery. Proven ability to build and run an enablement function or major program from the ground up in a fast-moving environment. Experience serving as a trusted advisor to senior Sales and/or Field Engineering leaders and turning business strategy into prioritized enablement outcomes. Exceptional written, verbal, storytelling, and presentation skills, including the ability to influence executives and engage large audiences. A measurement-oriented approach to enablement, with experience connecting readiness, skills, and behaviors to pipeline, consumption, ramp, or other business outcomes. Experience using AI technologies to create, scale, measure, or deliver enablement, plus the ability to build working knowledge of data and AI concepts, Lakehouse architecture, and the Databricks platform. text: CSQ128R188 Location: Sydney As a Forward Deployed Strategist (FDS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. title: Global SAP Consolidations Manager
text: GAQ327R292 We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve - leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. We are looking for a Global Consolidations Manager to join our Global Accounting team based in India. This is a foundational hire - you will own the end-to-end consolidation and intercompany accounting process across Databricks' 23-entity global footprint, build deep SAP Group Reporting expertise during our S/4HANA implementation, and establish the permanent organisational capability that scales with the business post go-live. This role blends hands-on consolidation execution with technical accounting judgment. As part of the Global Accounting organisation, you will ensure the accurate and timely production of consolidated financial statements under both US GAAP and IFRS, while partnering closely with International Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Tax, and FP&A to drive close integrity across all reporting frameworks. The impact you will have: Own and execute the global consolidation process end-to-end - intercompany reconciliation, elimination entries, currency translation, and multi-entity roll-up across our 23-entity footprint. Lead multi-GAAP close execution, producing parallel US GAAP and IFRS consolidated books each period, identifying and documenting reconciling differences for audit and leadership review. Build and own SAP Group Reporting expertise - serve as the accounting team's subject matter expert on SAP's consolidation engine, including configuration, period-end processing, and ongoing optimisation. Execute intercompany accounting across all entities - ensuring balances are reconciled, disputes are resolved within the close window, and elimination entries are complete and accurate. Perform monthly consolidation flux analysis, identifying and clearly articulating drivers behind significant period-over-period movements for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Own FX translation and revaluation accounting - functional currency determination, translation adjustments, and CTA reconciliation across all international entities. Support new entity stand-up - partner with Tax, Legal, and International Accounting to establish consolidation processes, intercompany agreements, and reporting structures for new international selling entities as Databricks expands. Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external audit on consolidation, intercompany, and multi-GAAP reporting matters. Champion compliance with SOX controls across the consolidation process. Drive AI and automation adoption across consolidation workflows - including automated intercompany matching, elimination entry generation, and reconciliation tooling leveraging the Databricks platform. Partner with the Senior Manager, Close & Consolidation (US) to ensure seamless handoff and time-zone coverage for the most time-sensitive part of the global close. What we look for: BA/BS Degree with a focus in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance. 10+ years progressive accounting experience, with at least 5+ years specifically in consolidation, intercompany accounting, or international accounting within a US multinational framework. A Chartered Accountant (CA) or CPA equivalent certification is mandatory. Deep understanding of US GAAP consolidation requirements (ASC 810, ASC 830) and working knowledge of IFRS consolidation standards (IFRS 10, IAS 21). Multi-GAAP reporting experience is strongly preferred. SAP S/4HANA experience required - specifically SAP Group Reporting or SAP BPC. Candidates with implementation experience will be prioritized. Proven experience managing intercompany accounting at scale - reconciliation, netting, dispute resolution, and elimination across a multi-entity, multi-currency environment. Experience with FX translation, functional currency assessment, and CTA accounting across complex international structures. Proven track record driving automation and process improvement in consolidation or close operations. Experience supporting external audits and SOX compliance in a consolidation context. Proven experience partnering with remote teams across different geographic areas, including with US-based accounting leadership, and the flexibility to support close timelines that span US Pacific Time hours. title: Global Workplace Services Manager, Events & Experiences
text: GAQ327R195 Databricks is one of the world’s fastest-growing data and AI companies—an industry leader transforming how organizations harness the power of their data. As we scale rapidly across the globe, we’re seeking an experienced, Global Workplace Services Lead with a focus on events & experiences to develop and drive the overarching strategy, design, and execution for events & experiences across our portfolio. The Real Estate & Workplace Services (REWS) team operates at an extremely fast pace, and we are in search of a leader with a startup mindset and fresh, innovative ideas to help us scale our events & experiences programming effectively. You will be instrumental in transforming our offices into vibrant community hubs through high-impact programming that builds culture and connection. You’ll also build scalable processes to support on-site business meetings & trainings, off-site experiences for large hubs and departments, and executive gatherings. We need a consistent, scalable approach with a local lens to support our unique cultures in each location. This role involves cultivating key relationships with third-party partners who are crucial to our expansion and growth. You’ll also collaborate internally with Workplace managers, our inclusion team, ERG leaders, executive admins, our training teams, and many more. The position reports directly to the AMER Workplace services leader with dotted lines to our Workplace leader over EMEA and APJ. This is a full-time, in-office role based in San Francisco, CA. Travel to critical hub locations is required to support the business and build the program. The impact you will have: Global Experience Strategy: Define and execute a multi-region workplace experience strategy that drives office attendance, fosters company culture, and strengthens employee community. Include a comprehensive operational roadmap, and timeline. Event Operations & Execution: Direct and be able to lead and liaise with local workplace specialists and outsourced teams the end-to-end planning and delivery for high-visibility workplace events, including weekly happy hours, monthly activations, business meetings and trainings, executive/board dinners, product launch celebrations, holiday gatherings, and community activations; Command on-site physical events, serving as the primary point of escalation to supervise and manage real-time staffing logistics, and conduct troubleshooting to safeguard attendee safety and experience. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal stakeholders—including Internal Communications, People/HR, Executive Assistants, Corporate Marketing, IT/AV, Security, food and beverage teams, and local workplace leaders and specialists—to ensure seamless event delivery. Strategic Stakeholder management: Provide exceptional interpersonal, negotiation, and diplomatic capabilities to seamlessly collaborate with, influence, and align global cross-functional stakeholders and executive leadership teams. Global Standards & Playbooks: Develop standardized global playbooks, service-level agreements (SLAs), and operational guidelines for local workplace teams to execute events consistently across regions. Vendor Management: Oversee global contracts and relationships with event production vendors, catering teams, and local event suppliers. Sellers actually use what you build. Adoption of your assets is high and rising, and reps reach for them in live customer conversations. Enablement stops being overhead and becomes a revenue lever the field can't sell without.
