title: Retail & Consumer Goods APAC Leader
text: SLSQ427R275 This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a playbook. As the Go-to-Market Leader for APAC Retail & Consumer Goods, you will architect and execute a category-defining strategy from the ground up. You'll operate with the mindset of a founder of a hyper-growth enterprise—a rare opportunity that demands entrepreneurial instincts, relentless drive, and the courage to build in ambiguity. Databricks is scaling at extraordinary speed. Databricks is the market share leader in data + AI in Retail & Consumer Goods, and this vertical represents one of the most significant growth opportunities in our portfolio. We need a leader who thrives in white space, who sees undefined territory not as risk but as canvas. You will shape how APAC’s largest retailers and consumer brands harness Data and AI to transform their operations, unlock new revenue streams, and reimagine customer experiences. You will report to the Global VP of Consumer Industries, but your impact will extend across the entire organization—influencing product direction, shaping partner ecosystems, and setting the strategic agenda for one of our most consequential markets. The impact you will have A Scalable APAC Growth Engine Design and execute a go-to-market strategy that doesn't yet exist in its final form. You’ll establish C-level relationships with flagship accounts, construct an ecosystem of ISVs, SIs, and alliance partners, and create repeatable motions that accelerate revenue growth across Retail, Consumer Goods, Restaurants, and Wholesale. Programmatic Opportunity Capture Identify the highest-value use cases and industry-specific opportunities—demand forecasting, unified customer intelligence, supply chain optimization, real-time pricing—and build scalable programs that systematically convert these opportunities into revenue. You won't pursue targets one at a time; you'll construct the engines, assets, and activation frameworks that allow us to capture entire categories of opportunity across the region simultaneously. A Partner Ecosystem from First Principles Identify, cultivate, and scale relationships with the partners who will amplify our reach. This isn't about managing existing relationships—it's about seeing what partnerships should exist and making them real. Data-Driven Operational Excellence Use rigorous analysis to surface gaps, inefficiencies, and untapped opportunities within our go-to-market approach. Build the feedback loops and improvement mechanisms that compound our effectiveness over time. Sales Plays That Travel Create comprehensive, scalable sales initiatives tailored to APAC’s diverse geographies while contributing frameworks that support Americas and EMEA. You'll work cross-functionally to ensure these plays move from concept to revenue. Industry Thought Leadership Establish Databricks as the authoritative voice in Retail & Consumer Goods transformation. Author white papers, command stages at premier industry events, and engage C-suite executives with a point of view that shapes how the market thinks about Data and AI. Cross-Functional Influence Serve as a trusted advisor across product, sales, pre-sales, marketing, and partner teams. Your credibility will be earned through results, and your influence will extend far beyond your formal remit. Market-Defining Content Collaborate with marketing to develop industry-specific collateral, demand generation campaigns, and event strategies that resonate with sophisticated enterprise buyers. Sales Team Acceleration Build enablement content and coaching programs that elevate the entire verticalized sales organization—making others more effective is as important as your direct contributions. What we look for An Industry Insider with Builder DNA You've held senior leadership or practitioner roles in Retail or Consumer Goods. You understand the industry's challenges from the inside—but you're energized by building something new rather than optimizing what exists. Entrepreneurial by Nature You've operated in environments where the path wasn't paved. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, moving quickly, and course-correcting based on market feedback. Ambiguity is where you do your best work. A GTM Architect You have extensive experience constructing vertical go-to-market programs on technology platforms, working cross-functionally to deliver measurable revenue growth and customer value. An Executive Relationship Builder You engage naturally with CXOs and senior business leaders. You create trust through substance, not just polish, and you know how to translate technical capability into strategic business value. A Transformation Leader You've led large-scale change initiatives and understand both the technical and human dimensions of enterprise transformation in complex organizations. Technically Fluent You possess deep familiarity with the data and AI landscape, retail technology standards, and the broader ecosystem trends reshaping the industry. Regulatory Aware You understand key APAC regulatory environments—such as data privacy, payments, sustainability, and sector-specific compliance—and can navigate these considerations in strategic conversations. A Program Operator You've managed complex vertical initiatives end-to-end: gathering requirements, coordinating technical teams, driving marketing alignment, and managing partner relationships to hit milestones. A Force Multiplier You have proven ability to train and enable sales teams, making the entire organization more effective at positioning solutions to Retail & Consumer Goods customers. title: Sales Specialist - Lakebase
text: SLSQ427R256 Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Sales Specialist Account Executive to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams. Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities. Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers. Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes. title: SAP Functional SME
text: GAQ126R41 About Databricks At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business. We're looking for an SAP Functional SME to own the functional design of our core finance processes on S/4HANA and to shape how AI and agentic automation reimagine them. In this role, you'll be the deep functional authority for your domain—translating how the business actually runs into standard, clean-core S/4HANA solutions, using process intelligence to find what's broken, and defining where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process . You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI, bridging Finance and Engineering to deliver a simpler, smarter, more automated experience. The Opportunity SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As the SAP Functional SME, you'll own the functional blueprint for those processes—leading discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design, configuring S/4HANA, and defining the requirements for the intelligent, agentic layer that automates routine work and guides users through exceptions and approvals. You'll use process mining and business process intelligence to quantify opportunity and prioritize what to build, and you'll make the call on where AI-driven recommendations belong versus deterministic rules. Your mission is to combine deep functional expertise with the power of Databricks AI to create a modern, highly automated finance experience that lets the business scale. What You'll Do Own Functional Design: Lead end-to-end process discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design for major finance processes (Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash), define S/4HANA solution scope, and design to standard, clean-core capabilities wherever possible. Configure S/4HANA: Own functional configuration, business rules, and master-data strategy for your domain, and partner with developers on extensions, APIs, and orchestration where standard functionality falls short. Drive Process Intelligence: Use process mining and business process intelligence (leveraging SAP Process Intelligence and related tools) to identify root causes, quantify opportunity, and prioritize improvements; translate those findings into concrete S/4HANA requirements. Shape the AI & Agentic Layer: Define the requirements for AI-assisted and agentic process improvements—task automation, intelligent recommendations, anomaly detection, and generative assistants—and make clear judgments about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process, where human-in-the-loop is required, and where a deterministic rule is the better answer. Bridge Business and Engineering: Serve as the connective tissue between Finance process owners and the engineering pods, partnering with architects and developers to embed AI safely and to define the data flows between S/4HANA, process intelligence tools, SAP BTP, and Databricks AI. Run Workshops and Validate Value: Facilitate stakeholder workshops to validate business value, define acceptance criteria, and lead user acceptance testing for both functional and AI features. Measure Outcomes: Define KPIs and track ROI for process improvements—cycle time, touchless transaction rate, exception and manual-touch reduction, adoption—and build the business cases for prioritized automation and AI initiatives. Enable Adoption: Coach and upskill process owners and functional teams on process intelligence, best practices, and AI adoption, and drive readiness and change management for what you ship. What You Bring 6+ years of SAP functional consulting experience , with hands-on delivery across at least one full S/4HANA lifecycle and deep expertise in one or more finance domains—Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, or Order-to-Cash—plus working fluency in adjacent areas and in master-data governance. Process Intelligence: Demonstrated experience leading process discovery, process mapping, and process mining using SAP Process Intelligence or equivalent BPI tools, and translating mining outputs into solution requirements. Clean-Core Mindset: Strong bias toward standard, clean-core S/4HANA design, with sound judgment about when a requirement genuinely warrants an extension versus a change in process. AI & Agentic Automation: Practical experience applying Databricks AI and agentic capabilities to enterprise processes, with strong judgment on where AI can drive automation and decision support while maintaining appropriate governance, controls, auditability, and human oversight. Integration Awareness: Solid understanding of integration patterns (APIs/OData, IDoc, SAP Integration Suite / BTP) and the data requirements that feed process mining and AI models. Governance Rigor: Working knowledge of SAP authorizations, SoD, SOX and audit requirements, and the ability to design processes and automation that satisfy them. Stakeholder Leadership: Excellent workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and change-management skills, and the ability to present executive-level ROI and translate technical capability into measurable business value. Business-First Mindset: Pragmatic, outcome-driven approach to reducing process waste and risk, and comfort leading through ambiguity across complex business and IT landscapes. Preferred Qualifications SAP S/4HANA Associate or Professional certification for a relevant module, and SAP Activate methodology experience. Certification or training in SAP Process Intelligence, or experience with Celonis or other process mining vendors. Hands-on experience delivering at least one AI-assisted process improvement in production. Familiarity with the SAP AI and extension stack (BTP, AI Core, Joule) and a point of view on build-versus-adopt tradeoffs against a Databricks-native approach. Experience working alongside data teams to make ERP data usable for analytics and AI on modern data platforms (such as Databricks), and prior work in a high-growth technology company where ERP had to scale quickly. In this role, you'll define the technical vision for a clean-core S/4HANA landscape, lead the engineers who build on it, and architect the intelligent, agentic AI layer that sits between SAP and the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You'll set the standards, make the hard build-versus-adopt calls, and ensure everything we ship is secure, performant, and built to scale. The Opportunity SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As the SAP Technical Lead, you will own how those processes are engineered—from the clean-core S/4HANA core and its extensions, to the integration fabric that connects SAP to the rest of the enterprise, to the AI and agentic services that make the experience intelligent. Rather than accumulating custom code inside the digital core, you'll champion a modern extensibility model on SAP BTP and the Databricks Lakehouse, so Finance teams get automated, AI-driven workflows on top of a core that stays clean, upgradable, and fast. Your mission is to combine the strength of SAP with the power of Databricks AI to build a technical foundation that lets the business scale. What You'll Do Own the Technical Architecture: Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for the S/4HANA landscape (greenfield, brownfield, or selective data transition), aligned to clean-core principles, with clear guardrails that keep the digital core standard and upgrade-ready. Lead the Extensibility Strategy: Define and own the extensibility strategy for SAP, using Databricks-native applications to address business requirements beyond core SAP capabilities. Establish clear architecture and governance standards to ensure extensions are scalable, secure, and aligned with the broader Finance technology strategy. Drive Enterprise AI Integration: Drive a strong integration with ongoing Enterprise AI transformation within Databricks by bringing AI fluency and hands on AI experience. Design the Integration Fabric: Architect secure, resilient integration across SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP Integration Suite, event-driven patterns, APIs, OData v4, and change-data feeds into the Lakehouse, with clear contracts, error handling, and observability. Unify SAP Data in the Lakehouse: Partner with data engineering on the technical patterns for landing SAP data in Databricks—ingestion, CDC, semantic and master-data modeling, lineage, and governance. Set Engineering Standards: Establish CI/CD, automated testing, and transport/deployment pipelines for BTP artifacts; own code and design reviews; and define the technical standards, security patterns, and best practices the team builds against. Lead the Team: Mentor developers and architects, lead technical steering, and act as the connective tissue across the SAP ecosystem (BTP, Integration Suite) and the systems around it, partnering closely with functional, product, and partner engineering teams. Be Accountable for Non-Functionals: Own performance, scalability, security, resilience, and cost across the landscape; report technical status, risks, and roadmaps to stakeholders. What You Bring 10+ years in SAP technical roles , with 3+ years as a technical lead or architect, and a proven track record delivering at least one full S/4HANA program (greenfield or conversion) plus BTP-based extension delivery. Clean-Core Architecture: Deep, hands-on command of clean-core principles—custom-code assessment and remediation, in-app vs. side-by-side extensibility, released APIs and extension points, and the governance that keeps the core clean over time. SAP BTP & Modern Development: Advanced experience across SAP BTP, ABAP Cloud and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), CDS, and CAP, with Fiori/SAPUI5 on the front end. AI & Agentic Systems: Hands-on experience or strong technical command of agentic automation, LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and evaluation—plus clear judgment about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable ERP process and where it does not. Integration & APIs: Advanced experience with SAP Integration Suite, API management, event-driven architecture, and REST/OData, integrating hybrid SAP and non-SAP landscapes. Data Fluency: Solid understanding of modern data platforms, SAP data extraction and modeling, pipelines, and semantic layers, and the practical work of making ERP data usable for analytics and AI. Governance Rigor: Working knowledge of SAP authorizations, SoD, SOX and audit requirements, and the ability to architect solutions and automation that satisfy them. Leadership: Ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture, present tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders, mentor engineers, and make pragmatic decisions that balance speed against long-term maintainability. Preferred Qualifications Experience building custom applications or automation layers on modern data platforms (such as Databricks) that extend or sit alongside SAP. A clear point of view on build-versus-adopt tradeoffs across the SAP AI and extension stack (BTP, AI Core, Joule) versus a Databricks-native approach. Hands-on knowledge of SAP integration surfaces and their limitations, including OData and REST APIs, CDS views, and Datasphere. Experience running Agile delivery with system integrators and managed service partners, including vendor and SLA accountability. SAP certification in SAP BTP, S/4HANA, or a relevant technology area, and prior work in a high-growth technology company where ERP had to scale quickly. title: Senior Compensation Manager, GTM
text: (GAQ327R299) Databricks is looking for a strategic compensation leader who likes to build. You'll be a trusted partner to founders and senior leadership in our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. You'll work with them to create compensation solutions that help us attract, retain and motivate world-class GTM talent, and you'll use AI to build the tools that make those solutions scale. This role reports to the Director of Compensation. At Databricks, we don't think of compensation as just a number. It's how we recognize that every employee is an owner and part of our success. We're looking for someone with a strong foundation and a track record of doing exactly that. What it takes to thrive Databricks is a deeply technical, fast-moving environment, and our GTM organization is a key engine of our growth. You'll partner with dynamic, data-driven leaders who value rigorous analysis, clear perspectives, and collaborative problem-solving. In this role, priorities can evolve quickly, and you'll often navigate multiple important initiatives at once. We set high standards for this role to support our fast-paced growth. Successful team members in this environment tend to: Build trust through analytical rigor. You present well-reasoned models and effectively articulate complex analysis to quantitative leaders. Navigate fast-paced priorities with resilience. You maintain focus, sound judgment, and positivity when balancing competing deadlines and feedback. Offer constructive perspectives. You confidently partner with senior stakeholders to propose data-backed alternative solutions and drive alignment to finalize decisions. Embrace feedback as a growth tool. You extract actionable insights from feedback and respond with clarity and openness. Create order from ambiguity. When there's no playbook, you build one, and you're comfortable acting on 80% of the information. If you are excited by high standards, technical depth, and collaborative strategic discussions, you will find this work deeply rewarding. The impact you will have This is a hands-on, high-impact role. Expected time on each area: GTM compensation solutions and strategic advice (40%) Work directly with GTM leaders to diagnose talent challenges such as competitive attrition, hard-to-fill roles, rapid scaling and reorganizations, and design attraction and retention solutions that fix them. Turn vague or urgent requests into clear options with explicit tradeoffs, then help leaders reach a decision. Serve as the main compensation advisor on strategic executive hires and high-stakes retention situations. AI-enabled lifecycle compensation (30%) Run merit, refresh equity and promotion cycles end to end for global GTM teams. Design and build AI tools and workflows that reduce manual work and improve decisions. Examples include offer modeling, retention-risk analysis, cycle quality checks, and self-serve insights for leaders. Spot what's repetitive or error-prone in today's processes and automate it. Enterprise compensation frameworks (30%) Help scale Databricks' global compensation structure, including market pricing models, pay-for-performance design and equity strategy. Build frameworks that solve today's problems and anticipate the ones coming as we grow. What we look for Quantitative and technical skill is the foundation of this role. Everything else we look for builds on it. 1. Quantitative and technical foundation (required) Expert-level analytical modeling. You build compensation models from scratch, including cost-of-program scenarios, pay-positioning analysis, attrition and retention-risk modeling, and sensitivity and tradeoff analysis. Built with AI. You've personally used AI tools (for example LLMs, AI assistants, or automation and agent platforms) to build compensation tools, models or workflows that others rely on. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to explain how it works, what you'd improve, and how you checked that its outputs were accurate. Equity fluency. You understand RSU and option mechanics, vesting design, refresh strategy, and how grant values and share price movement affect cost and retention. Statistical judgment. You know when a market data cut is credible, when a sample is too small, and how to present ranges and market pricing without false precision. 2. Compensation expertise (required) You know your craft. Job architecture, compensation frameworks, market pricing, year-end and mid-year pay cycles, global compensation practices, and pay-for-performance design. You know the competition. Deep knowledge of competitor compensation, especially new-hire and refresh equity strategy at high-growth and public tech companies. You reason from first principles. You balance compensation best practice with what the business actually needs, and you can rebuild a framework from its underlying logic when the standard approach doesn't fit. 3. Strategic partnership (required) Trusted advisor to senior leaders. title: Senior Customer Enablement AI Programs Manager
text: CSQ426R319 Senior Customer Enablement AI Programs Manager As a Senior Customer Enablement AI Programs Manager, you will own the AI strategy and roadmap for the Scaled Customer Enablement Agent Suite — bringing together GTM activation, applied AI, and enablement strategy. You will define how the agents retrieve, reason over, and surface enablement insights to global Account Teams, turning learner and account data into prescriptive, just-in-time recommendations that improve account health and grow the number of trained users across our customer base. By automating GTM processes, you will ensure Account Teams and customers receive consistent Databricks enablement planning resources. You will be responsible for driving the AI roadmap for customer enablement, compounding enablement as a strategic leverage for our customers and for Databricks. This role will report to the Global Customer Enablement Practice Senior Director. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated and innovative entrepreneur with a passion for working across departments and across regions. The impact you will have: Own the product roadmap and architecture direction for the Scaled Customer Enablement Agent Suite — defining the data inputs, retrieval sources, and agent behaviors that generate enablement recommendations. Lead the rollout and drive field adoption of the Scaled Customer Enablement Agent Suite, delivering automated learning insights and proposals to Account Teams. Structure the enablement knowledge base for retrieval — designing content schemas, metadata, and chunking so agents return accurate, grounded outputs — and maintain the underlying customer enablement playbook. Define the signals and triggers — usage patterns, learning milestones, and account-health thresholds — that prompt the agents to surface a free-to-paid enablement opportunity to Account Teams at the right moment. Partner with technical teams to embed enablement calls-to-action and insights directly into field tools. Define predictive signals and analytics that flag emerging account-health and skills gaps before they impact renewals or consumption, and integrate these into leadership reviews and manager coaching toolkits. Establish evaluation and quality loops for agent outputs — defining what “good” looks like, measuring accuracy and groundedness, and driving iteration with the technical team. What we look for 6+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, GTM Program Management, or Sales Operations in a high-growth SaaS environment. Proven track record of managing complex workstreams and delivering global field motions with measurable adoption. Hands-on fluency with modern AI systems — RAG pipelines, agents, and LLM-powered workflows. You understand how retrieval sources, prompt design, context and data hierarchies, and grounding affect output quality, and can translate that into requirements a technical team can build against. Demonstrated experience owning a product or system area end to end — defining requirements, collaborating with engineering and data teams, and shipping AI-powered capabilities from concept to field adoption. Comfort defining metrics and running experiments — instrumenting agent performance, measuring output quality and field adoption, and using analytics to drive iteration. Exceptional ability to work cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing, and Technical teams to ensure a unified enablement vision. Expert at using data dashboards to track progress and communicate the "business story" behind the numbers (e.g., the link between enabled users and consumption lift). Able to solve ambiguous problems in a fast-moving environment and translate complex strategies into simple, executable field instructions. Familiarity with the education technology or customer training landscape is a significant plus. Familiarity with how enablement and knowledge content must be structured for machine consumption (schemas, metadata, modularity) is a strong plus. The Self-Serve team owns Databricks' product-led growth motion — the experience that takes someone from "I just heard about Databricks" to succeeding on the platform entirely on their own. Our most ambitious bet is Learning: making Databricks the place where anyone interested in data + AI comes to learn, and building the largest community of active, capable learners in the world. It's a long game with a simple thesis — if people learn data + AI on Databricks, it becomes ubiquitous with the field itself, driving adoption and revenue. As a Senior Engineering Manager on the Self-Serve team, you will lead the Learning bet end to end across two sides: self-paced learning — a place to learn any Databricks skill, hands-on labs that spin up inside a real workspace, and a durable skill profile a learner carries across jobs — and enterprise-managed learning, giving admins the tools to assign, track, and grow learning inside their orgs. AI is central to both: a content-generation agent that scales the catalog far past what we could author by hand, and an AI tutor that guides learners hands-on inside the product. This is a genuine 0→1 product with real systems depth — on-demand provisioning, identity, sandboxing, and an interactive learning engine that must scale to millions of learners — and you'll grow and lead a team of ~12 engineers (planned to roughly double) to build it. title: Senior Manager Compensation R&D
text: GAQ127R143 Databricks is looking for a strategic compensation leader who likes to build. You'll be a trusted partner to founders and senior leaders in our Engineering organization. Together you'll create compensation solutions that help us attract, retain and motivate world-class engineering and technical talent, and you'll use AI to build the tools that make those solutions scale. This role reports to the Director of Compensation. At Databricks, compensation is more than a number. It's how we show that every employee is an owner and part of our success. We're looking for someone with a strong foundation and a track record of doing exactly that. What it takes to thrive Databricks is a deeply technical, fast-moving company, and our Engineering organization builds the platform everything else runs on. You'll partner with highly technical, data-driven leaders who expect rigorous analysis, clear points of view and collaborative problem-solving. Priorities can change quickly, and you'll often run several important initiatives at once. We set high standards for this role to support our fast-paced growth. Successful team members in this environment tend to: Build trust through analytical rigor. You present well-reasoned models and effectively articulate complex analysis to engineering leaders who will test your assumptions. Navigate fast-paced priorities with resilience. You maintain focus, sound judgment, and positivity when balancing competing deadlines and feedback. Offer constructive perspectives. You confidently partner with senior stakeholders to propose data-backed alternative solutions and drive alignment to finalize decisions. Embrace feedback as a growth tool. You extract actionable insights from feedback and respond with clarity and openness. Create order from ambiguity. When there's no playbook, you build one, and you're comfortable acting on 80% of the information. If you are excited by high standards, technical depth, and collaborative strategic discussions, you will find this work deeply rewarding. The impact you will have This is a hands-on, high-impact role. Expected time on each area: Engineering compensation solutions and strategic advice (40%) Work directly with Engineering leaders to diagnose talent challenges, such as competition for AI/ML and infrastructure talent, hard-to-fill specialist roles, rapid team scaling, acquisitions and reorganizations. Then design attraction and retention solutions that solve them. Turn vague or urgent requests into clear options with explicit tradeoffs, and help leaders reach a decision. Serve as the main compensation advisor on strategic technical hires (senior ICs, distinguished engineers, research leaders and engineering executives) and on high-stakes retention cases. Advise on technical leveling, including IC and management career paths and how compensation should differ across them. AI-enabled lifecycle compensation (30%) Run merit, refresh equity and promotion cycles end to end for global R&D teams. Design and build AI tools and workflows that reduce manual work and improve decisions. Examples include offer modeling, retention-risk analysis, cycle quality checks, and self-serve insights for leaders. Spot what's repetitive or error-prone in today's processes and automate it. Enterprise compensation frameworks (30%) Help scale Databricks' global compensation structure, including market pricing models, pay-for-performance design, equity strategy and technical job architecture. Build frameworks that solve today's problems and anticipate the ones coming as we grow, including emerging skill premiums such as AI/ML. What we look for Quantitative and technical skill is the foundation of this role. Everything else we look for builds on it. 1. Quantitative and technical foundation (required) Expert-level analytical modeling. You build compensation models from scratch, including cost-of-program scenarios, pay-positioning analysis, attrition and retention-risk modeling, and sensitivity and tradeoff analysis. Built with AI. You've personally used AI tools (for example LLMs, AI assistants, or automation and agent platforms) to build compensation tools, models or workflows that others rely on. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to explain how it works, what you'd improve, and how you checked that its outputs were accurate. Equity fluency. You understand RSU and option mechanics, vesting design, refresh strategy, and how grant values and share price movement affect cost and retention, especially for long-tenured, high-equity technical talent. Statistical judgment. You know when a market data cut is credible, when a sample is too small (common with niche technical roles), and how to present ranges and market pricing without false precision. 2. Compensation expertise (required) You know your craft. Job architecture, technical career ladders, compensation frameworks, market pricing, year-end and mid-year pay cycles, global compensation practices, and pay-for-performance design. You know the competition. Deep knowledge of competitor compensation for high-tech talent, especially new-hire and refresh equity strategy at high-growth tech companies, public tech companies, and AI labs. You reason from first principles. You balance compensation best practice with what the business actually needs, and you can rebuild a framework from its underlying logic when the standard approach doesn't fit. 3. Strategic partnership (required) Trusted advisor to senior leaders. You have a track record of advising executives on sensitive, high-stakes compensation decisions (offers, promotions, leveling, retention, transfers, org changes) and influencing the outcome through data and judgment rather than authority. Operational excellence. You connect the dots between systems, stakeholders and programs to deliver compensation programs end to end, accurately and on time. Clear communicator. You turn complex analysis into a crisp recommendation an executive can act on in one conversation. Nice-to-haves Experience supporting Engineering, R&D or other technical organizations at a high-growth tech company. Familiarity with the market for AI/ML, research or specialized infrastructure talent. Experience with acquisition (including acqui-hire) compensation and retention design. Experience with Tableau or other BI tools, or building dashboards for leaders. Experience scaling compensation programs through hypergrowth, IPO, or major organizational change. A background in a quantitative field (for example finance, statistics, engineering), or equivalent experience. You will tackle some of the most complex challenges related to capacity planning, performance optimization, reliability engineering, infrastructure efficiency, and customer experience. You will lead a team of data scientists and work directly in partnership with engineering leaders to empower them with data-driven insights and solutions. At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. title: Senior Manager, Real Estate & Workplace Services - India
text: P-1628 Mission Databricks is one of the world's fastest-growing data and AI companies, transforming how organisations harness the power of their data. As we continue to scale across India, we're looking for an experienced and forward-thinking Senior Manager, Real Estate & Workplace Services – India to lead our workplace operations and employee experience across Bangalore, Mumbai and Delhi. Our Real Estate & Workplace Services (REWS) team operates in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment. We're looking for a leader who brings a startup mindset, combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, and is passionate about creating workplaces where our employees can do their best work. This role will have end-to-end accountability for workplace services across India, with Bangalore serving as our largest operational hub. You'll be responsible for creating an exceptional, consistent employee experience while ensuring our workplaces are safe, efficient, financially responsible and positioned to support the next phase of Databricks' growth. You will lead and develop our local workplace teams, oversee our outsourced Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) partners, and build strong relationships across the business. Beyond delivering excellent day-to-day operations, you'll be expected to anticipate future needs, challenge existing ways of working and introduce scalable processes, data-driven insights and AI-enabled solutions that improve how we operate. This is a highly visible leadership role requiring someone who can navigate complex operational challenges, influence senior stakeholders, and balance the needs of a rapidly growing business with long-term operational sustainability. The position is based in Bangalore, with regular travel to Mumbai and Delhi and occasional international travel. Outcomes Own and execute the workplace services strategy across Bangalore, Mumbai and Delhi, ensuring our workplaces support business growth, operational excellence and an exceptional employee experience. Lead all aspects of workplace operations, including facilities, catering, hospitality, amenities and employee services, ensuring consistent standards, efficiency and accountability across the portfolio. Build, coach and develop a high-performing workplace team, creating a culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement while planning for future growth. Create welcoming, inclusive and engaging workplaces that reflect Databricks' culture, using employee feedback and data to continuously elevate services and experiences. Own strategic supplier relationships, including IFM and catering partners, driving performance, innovation, commercial value and service excellence. Own India workplace budgets, forecasting and financial performance, identifying opportunities to optimise costs, improve productivity and deliver measurable business value. Build trusted relationships with senior business leaders and cross-functional teams, influencing decisions, aligning priorities and proactively managing complex operational challenges. Partner with Real Estate, Design & Construction and other stakeholders to support office expansions, relocations and operational transitions, ensuring workplaces are ready to scale. Ensure all workplaces meet local regulatory and health and safety requirements, and maintain strong governance, risk management, and business continuity. Champion data-driven decision-making, AI and automation to simplify processes, improve operational performance and create scalable ways of working. Requirements 15+ years of experience in workplace services, facilities management, real estate operations or hospitality, ideally within a fast-growing global technology company. Proven experience leading multi-site workplace operations, with strong knowledge of the Indian market, particularly Bangalore, Mumbai and Delhi. Demonstrated ability to develop and execute workplace strategies, manage complex operational challenges and drive measurable business outcomes. Strong people leadership experience, with a track record of building, coaching and developing high-performing teams, including outsourced service partners. Experience managing large-scale workplace operations, including facilities, catering, hospitality, employee experience and workplace services. Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget ownership, forecasting, cost optimisation, procurement and contract management. Proven ability to manage strategic vendor relationships, particularly Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) providers, driving service excellence, accountability and continuous improvement. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership, navigate competing priorities and work effectively across functions. Strong understanding of Indian workplace regulations, health and safety, statutory compliance and operational risk management. Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple priorities, complex projects and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. A data-driven and solutions-focused mindset, with experience using operational metrics, technology, AI and automation to improve efficiency and service delivery. A customer-focused approach with a passion for hospitality, employee experience and consistently delivering high-quality workplace services. Experience supporting office expansions, relocations, workplace mobilisation and change management. Proficiency with Google Workspace and collaborative workplace management tools; experience with Asana, Freshservice and similar platforms preferred. A proactive, adaptable leader with a startup mindset, strong judgment and the confidence to operate independently while knowing when to escalate or challenge decisions. title: Senior Payroll Accountant
text: GAQ327R161 About the Role We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Senior Payroll Accountant plays a critical role in executing the day-to-day and month-end accounting tasks associated with Databricks' global payroll. As part of the Global Accounting organization and reporting directly to the Payroll Accounting Manager based in India, you will tackle complex reconciliations, execute detailed variance analysis, and drive process improvements. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical self-starter with a keen eye for detail who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. title: Senior Payroll Analyst
text: GAQ327R247 As part of the Databricks Payroll team, you will join a dynamic global organisation that is helping our customers solve some of their toughest problems. You will also ensure our employees are paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with all requirements—allowing them to focus on doing their best work. This role is ideal for a payroll professional who loves hands-on processing, thrives on problem-solving, and brings strong systems skills to handle complex payroll cases without escalation. The Senior Payroll Analyst will work closely with the Payroll Director to support accurate and timely payroll processing for our Asia region—specifically Australia, Korea, Japan & Singapore, this may change as per org need and design. You will collaborate with payroll vendors, internal partners, and employees to deliver compliant, efficient payroll operations. While you will not be solely responsible for payroll execution, you will play a key role in preparing, validating, and reconciling payroll data, responding to employee inquiries, and supporting projects and process improvements. This role reports to the Payroll Director based in UK. The impact you will have: Payroll processing support – Partner with the Payroll Analyst team in India to prepare, validate, and reconcile payroll data for the countries specified above or as per org design, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery. Data validation & audits – Perform pre- and post-processing checks to identify and resolve discrepancies before payroll is finalized. Vendor collaboration – Work closely with payroll vendors to troubleshoot issues, resolve variances, and meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Compliance adherence – Ensure payroll operations follow internal controls, statutory regulations, and company policies for each country. Employee case resolution – Respond to and resolve payroll inquiries through the case management tool, providing accurate and timely support. Process improvement – Identify and recommend scalable solutions to enhance payroll efficiency and accuracy. Documentation maintenance – Develop and update payroll process documentation to support consistency and knowledge sharing. Project participation – Contribute to payroll-related projects, system enhancements, and testing activities in the ASIA region. What we look for: Regional payroll expertise – 5-7 years of payroll processing experience in Asia region. Global Team Environment - experience working for a multinational and high-growth company. text: A newly created role to help Databricks create new product categories. title: Senior SAP Developer
text: GAQ126R44 About Databricks At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business. We're looking for a SAP Developer to build the applications, extensions, and integrations that bring this vision to life. In this role, you'll write clean-core extensions on SAP BTP, build full-stack apps and Fiori experiences, wire up integrations between SAP and the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, and help embed AI and agentic capabilities directly into finance workflows. You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI—shipping software that makes finance operations faster, smarter, and more automated. The Opportunity SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As an SAP Developer, you'll be hands-on-keyboard building the layer that makes those processes intelligent: side-by-side extensions on BTP, event-driven integrations into the Lakehouse, and AI-assisted workflows that automate routine work and guide users through exceptions and approvals. You'll build with modern SAP and Databricks AI tooling—combining SAP’s core ERP capabilities with Databricks-native AI, agentic applications, and automation—while keeping the SAP digital core clean, scalable, and upgradable. Your mission is to turn designs into robust, production-grade software that combines the strength of SAP with the power of Databricks AI. What You'll Do Build Clean-Core Extensions: Develop in-app and side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP that keep the S/4HANA digital core clean and upgrade-ready, using released APIs and extension points rather than core modifications. Develop Databricks-Native Applications: Build scalable, full-stack applications and services on the Databricks platform that extend and integrate with SAP, leveraging Databricks-native capabilities, APIs, data services, and AI/agentic tooling to deliver modern Finance experiences while keeping the SAP core clean. Build Integrations: Implement secure, resilient integrations across SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP Integration Suite, event-driven patterns, APIs, OData v4, and change-data feeds into the Databricks Lakehouse, with solid error handling and monitoring. Embed AI & Agentic Capabilities: Build AI-powered and agentic capabilities into Finance workflows using Databricks AI, integrating seamlessly with SAP and other enterprise systems. Apply RAG, prompt engineering, tool calling, and human-in-the-loop controls to automate processes safely while maintaining governance and auditability Move SAP Data to the Lakehouse: Partner with data engineering to build the pipelines and extraction patterns (CDC, OData, APIs) that land SAP data in Databricks cleanly, with attention to modeling, lineage, and data quality. Engineer for Quality: Write unit and integration tests, work within CI/CD and transport pipelines for ABAP and BTP artifacts, participate in code reviews, and follow the team's security and coding standards. Collaborate: Work closely with the technical lead, functional experts, and product owners to turn requirements and designs into working software, and iterate quickly based on user feedback. What You Bring 6+ years of SAP development experience , with hands-on delivery of at least one end-to-end SAP solution (an S/4HANA extension, a CAP or RAP app on BTP with Fiori, or an Integration Suite flow) in production. Modern ABAP: Strong command of ABAP Cloud, ABAP CDS, and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), plus OData (v2/v4). SAP BTP: Working-to-advanced experience with BTP runtimes, core services (Connectivity, Destination, XSUAA/auth), and deploying, securing, and operating apps on the platform. Front End: Solid experience with SAP Fiori concepts, SAPUI5, and Fiori Elements (OData v4). Integration: Experience with SAP Integration Suite / API Management and event-driven patterns (OData/REST, IDoc, Cloud Integration, Event Mesh) across hybrid landscapes. AI Fluency: Strong understanding of SAP and Databricks AI capabilities, with practical knowledge of generative AI and agentic concepts—including RAG, prompt engineering, grounding, tool calling, and enterprise AI governance. Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications and workflows on Databricks and integrating them with SAP is a strong plus. Engineering Practice: Comfort with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern dev tooling (VS Code, ABAP Development Tools in Eclipse, MTA/CF packaging). Clean-Core Mindset: Understanding of clean-core principles and why extensions belong side-by-side or in-app rather than in the digital core. Collaboration: Clear communicator who can work across functional, product, and engineering teams and take ownership of what they ship. Preferred Qualifications Domain knowledge in finance, procurement, or supply chain that speeds delivery and requirements understanding. Experience extending or customizing Joule agents via SAP Build / Joule Studio, or building agents on SAP AI Foundation. Experience building applications on modern data platforms (such as Databricks) that extend or sit alongside SAP. Cloud-native experience—containerization and Kubernetes (Kyma), observability, and scalability patterns. title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Runtime
location: Mountain View, California; San Francisco, California
text: P-1428 At Databricks, we run the world's largest AI platform. We believe the next breakthroughs will come from models trained on domain-specific enterprise data, not from bigger general-purpose models alone. That's why we built AI Runtime , a serverless product that makes GPU training of any size feel simple, so companies can train their own models the way frontier labs do. Customers across industries train on it, right next to the enterprise data already in Databricks. Among them are Rivian in automotive, Robinhood in fintech, and Merck, which builds foundation models for drug discovery. Our own AI researchers use it to post-train models with hundreds of billions to nearly a trillion parameters. It takes a lot of engineering to make that work, and we've written about it on our blog: how we keep GPUs reliable , make training fault-tolerant , and speed up fine-tuning with fused kernels and smart sequence packing. AI agents now launch experiments too, and on our research team they've already increased training jobs 8x . As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll work on the systems behind all of this, solving hard technical problems and helping shape how AI Runtime evolves. The impact you will have: Build core parts of AI Runtime and contribute to Databricks' technical direction in AI training infrastructure. Develop reliability and observability features for a fleet that keeps growing in scale and complexity. Improve AI Runtime's developer experience for people and agents, so even the largest training jobs feel as simple as a first experiment. Help prepare AI Runtime for new GPU generations and workload types. Take on hard multi-node training problems, from orchestration and GPU scheduling to data loading and checkpointing. Make training faster and cheaper by raising efficiency across model architectures and GPU accelerators. Work with research, product, and customers on what we build next and own features from design through production. Champion engineering excellence, raise the bar, and help the engineers around you grow. What we look for: 5+ years in large-scale distributed systems, with experience in GPU training, high-performance computing, or ML systems. Experience training large models with FSDP, DeepSpeed, or Megatron, and familiarity with parallelism strategies. Working knowledge of GPU performance, including accelerator architecture, high-speed interconnects, and kernels. Strong understanding of training resilience patterns, such as checkpointing, failure detection, and automatic recovery. A background in building and running multi-tenant cloud platforms as products. A track record of owning complex features end to end and seeing them through to customer impact. The clarity to explain technical designs in writing and in person, and a reputation as a teammate others learn from. BS in Computer Science or a related field (MS or PhD preferred). title: Senior Software Engineer - Database Engine Internals
text: P-1415 Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the whole data lifecycle from ingestion to ETL, BI, and all the way up to ML/AI with a unified platform. To achieve this goal, we believe the data warehouse architecture as we know it today will be replaced by a new architectural pattern, Lakehouse ( CIDR 2021 paper ), open platforms that unify data warehousing and advanced analytics. This new architecture will help address several major challenges, including data staleness, reliability, total cost of ownership, data lock-in, and limited use-case support. title: Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Data Systems
text: P-59 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. Modern data analysis employs sophisticated methods such as machine learning that go well beyond the roll-up and drill-down capabilities of traditional SQL query engines. As a software engineer on the Runtime team at Databricks, you will be building the next generation distributed data storage and processing systems that can outperform specialized SQL query engines in relational query performance, yet provide the expressiveness and programming abstractions to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science. Below are some example projects: Apache Spark™ : Develop the de facto open source standard framework for big data. Data Plane Storage : Provide reliable and high performance services and client libraries for storing and accessing humongous amount of data on cloud storage backends, e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob Store. Delta Lake : A storage management system that combines the scale and cost-efficiency of data lakes, the performance and reliability of a data warehouse, and the low latency of streaming. Its higher level abstractions and guarantees, including ACID transactions and time travel, drastically simplify the complexity of real-world data engineering architecture. Delta Pipelines : It's difficult to manage even a single data engineering pipeline. The goal of the Delta Pipelines project is to make it simple and possible to orchestrate and operate tens of thousands of data pipelines. It provides a higher level abstraction for expressing data pipelines and enables customers to deploy, test & upgrade pipelines and eliminate operational burdens for managing and building high quality data pipelines. Performance Engineering : Build the next generation query optimizer and execution engine that's fast, tuning free, scalable, and robust. What we look for: BS (or higher) in Computer Science, related technical field or equivalent practical experience. Comfortable working towards a multi-year vision with incremental deliverables. Motivated by delivering customer value and impact. 5+ years of production level experience in either Java, Scala or C++. Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures and their real-world use cases. Experience with distributed systems, databases, and big data systems (Apache Spark™, Hadoop). title: Senior Solutions Architect (EDW Enterprise Data Warehouse Migrations)
text: At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems. Our customers leverage the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to power their mission critical Data and AI applications to improve how their organisations leverage data and insights to make better decisions, faster. Customers rely on Databricks for the full range of data workloads, including data engineering, ETL, near real-time streaming, machine learning, SQL analytics, and advanced analytics. The Solutions Architect (EDW Migrations) executes on Databricks’ strategic product lines to develop, establish and drive product adoption and product market fit to grow customer adoption across EMEA. By working with leadership, product and direct account teams, you will jointly engage customers, foster the necessary relationships and position in-depth approaches to migrating their EDW to the Databricks Intelligence Platform. You will develop the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed for customers to successfully deliver on their business objectives. The Solutions Architect (EDW Migrations) is paired with Product Specialists for Data and Governance. Together, you will devise and implement a strategy across key accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets, and with account teams deliver them such that the field and customers make informed decisions on adoption strategy and its implementation. The impact you will have Lead Regional Migration Strategy: Collaborate with EMEA GTM leadership and account teams to design and drive the technical GTM and adoption strategy for large-scale EDW migrations to the Databricks Intelligence Platform Develop Programmatic and Scalable Migration Processes: Architect and continuously refine programmatic assets and detailed technical guides that enable field teams and partners to execute migrations. Build and Integrate Assessment Tooling: Help maintain, enhance, and direct the development of automated assessment tools from customer engagements. Drive Tier-3 Technical Championship: Act as the ultimate technical escalation point for highly complex, strategic, or stalled migrations in must-win accounts across EMEA. Enable and Scale the Regional teams: Scale the presales migration practice by mentoring and coaching the EMEA community of Solutions Architects (SAs) and Specialist SAs (SSAs) to ensure scale. Bridge Field Insights and Product R&D: Serve as a primary technical feedback loop to Product Management and Engineering. Establish Industry Thought Leadership: Author whitepapers, publish technical blogs, and deliver high-impact presentations at public forums (such as the Data + AI Summit) to position the Databricks Intelligence Platform as the premier platform for enterprise database modernization. Whether an agent is answering a question about last quarter's revenue, debugging a failing job, generating SQL against a 10,000-table lakehouse, or summarizing a Wiki page, its quality is bounded by what it can find — and how well it understands what it finds. We are hiring a Senior Staff Applied AI Engineer to own context retrieval for Databricks agents across SaaS providers . This is a zero-to-one role with two deeply connected charters: Build the retrieval stack — query understanding, content understanding, ranking, retrieval, and evaluation — across the Enterprise SaaS data stored across multiple systems. Build the search subagents that sit on top of that stack and reason about what context is needed , how to retrieve it , and whether the right thing actually came back — closing the loop between an agent's intent and the substrate that serves it. If you have deep Information Retrieval wisdom, have shipped retrieval systems for RAG and agentic workloads, and want to build the substrate — and the agents on top of it — that make every Databricks agent measurably smarter, this role is for you. What You Will Do Build the full retrieval stack from scratch. Own the end-to-end system: query understanding, content understanding and indexing, hybrid retrieval, ranking, and evaluation. Make the architectural calls that will define how Databricks agents access context for years to come. Retrieve across heterogeneous data — structured and unstructured. Index and rank across structured assets (tables, columns, SQL queries, dashboards, code, notebooks, jobs) and unstructured content (docs, wikis, tickets, chat, images, video, audio). Each modality has its own signals — design retrieval that exploits them rather than flattens them. Connect to the SaaS surface area customers actually use. Build connectors and retrieval adapters for the systems where enterprise knowledge lives. Treat each retrieval source with its own freshness, permissions, and ranking signals. Optimize for two consumers at once. Retrieval must serve both LLMs (grounded, token-efficient, hallucination-resistant context) and humans (intuitive, explainable discovery). These are different objectives and require different signals — own both. Crack query understanding for agents. Agent queries don't look like web queries. Build query rewriting, decomposition, intent classification, and entity resolution tuned for multi-turn agentic workflows. Crack content understanding at scale. Build the pipelines that extract structure, entities, embeddings, summaries, and metadata from every supported asset type — and keep them fresh as customer data evolves. Build search subagents that reason about retrieval. Design the agentic layer that decides what context is needed , which sources to query , how to decompose and route the search , and — critically — whether the retrieved content is actually sufficient to answer the question . These subagents will plan multi-hop searches, issue follow-up queries when results are weak, ground claims against retrieved evidence, and hand back high-confidence context (or signal failure) to upstream agents. This is where IR meets agentic reasoning. Build the evaluation flywheel for both retrieval and subagents. Stand up offline evals (nDCG, MRR, Recall@K, Precision@K), LLM-as-judge harnesses, human-in-the-loop labeling, and online experimentation. Extend evaluation beyond ranking metrics to measure subagent decision quality — did it ask the right follow-up? , did it correctly recognize when retrieval failed? , did it ground its answer in the right evidence? . Quality you can't measure is quality you can't ship. Set technical direction and grow the team. Set the multi-year roadmap, mentor senior engineers, partner with Research, Product, and Platform leaders, and raise the technical bar across the org. What We're Looking For 10+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent building production retrieval, search, or RAG systems at scale. Deep Information Retrieval (IR) expertise : lexical retrieval (BM25, Lucene/Elasticsearch/OpenSearch), dense retrieval (embeddings, ANN indexes — FAISS, ScaNN, HNSW), hybrid retrieval, and learning-to-rank. Hands-on experience with modern LLM-era retrieval : RAG architectures, query rewriting, re-ranking with cross-encoders, long-context strategies, and grounding techniques that reduce hallucination. Experience designing agentic systems on top of retrieval — search planners, multi-hop / iterative retrieval, self-reflection and sufficiency checks, tool-using agents that decide what to fetch and verify what came back. Strong grasp of relevance evaluation : nDCG, MRR, Precision@K, Recall@K; offline/online experimentation; LLM-as-judge frameworks; building human labeling pipelines. Experience working across structured and unstructured data — you've indexed and ranked over tables, code, and documents in the same system, and have opinions about how to do it well. Track record of building 0→1 : you've stood up a retrieval system from an empty repo, made the foundational architectural decisions, and grown it into something that customers depend on. Demonstrated ability to operate as a technical leader : setting direction across teams, mentoring senior engineers, and influencing roadmap with research, product, and platform partners. Nice to Have Experience building retrieval over enterprise SaaS sources (permissions, freshness, multi-tenancy, ACL-aware indexing). Background in agentic systems, tool use, or multi-turn retrieval for LLM agents. Contributions to open-source IR/search projects, or publications at SIGIR, KDD, WWW, EMNLP, or similar venues. Experience training or fine-tuning embedding models, rerankers, or query understanding models. Why This Role Foundational impact. Retrieval is the single biggest lever on agent quality. The stack you build will sit underneath every Databricks agent and every customer-built agent on our platform. Greenfield with scale. You get the rare combination of starting from a clean sheet and having immediate access to massive enterprise scale, real customer data, and a world-class research org. The right team. You'll work alongside engineers and researchers behind Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake, MLflow, MosaicML, and DBRX. text: P-1096 At Databricks, we run the world's largest AI platform. We believe the next breakthroughs will come from models trained on domain-specific enterprise data, not from bigger general-purpose models alone. That's why we built AI Runtime , a serverless product that makes GPU training of any size feel simple, so companies can train their own models the way frontier labs do. Customers across industries train on it, right next to the enterprise data already in Databricks. Among them are Rivian in automotive, Robinhood in fintech, and Merck, which builds foundation models for drug discovery. It takes a lot of engineering to make that work, and we've written about it on our blog: how we keep GPUs reliable , make training fault-tolerant , and speed up fine-tuning with fused kernels and smart sequence packing. AI agents now launch experiments too, and on our research team they've already increased training jobs 8x . title: Senior Staff Software Engineer- Search Quality
text: P-1408 The Mission We are democratizing Data and AI for every enterprise user. Our vision is a world where anyone can master their organization’s data through Apps and AI Agents. We are building the retrieval backbone for two worlds: the high-precision context layer for AI agents and the intuitive search experience for people goal is the same: instant, accurate, and actionable insight. The Role : As a Search Quality Engineer, you sit at the heart of this transformation. You aren't just building a search engine; you are building the contextual backbone of the entire company. You will own the quality of results for two distinct but deeply connected "users": The AI Agent: Optimizing the retrieval layer that allows LLMs to reason over data they weren’t trained on, ensuring they have the "ground truth" needed to synthesize accurate, high-stakes business actions. The Human User: Improving the traditional search experience so employees can find assets and answers through intuitive, high-recall interfaces. The Technical Challenge This isn't a solved problem. You will be tackling "Search" in its most evolved form: Hybrid Retrieval: Balancing traditional keyword-based search (for exactness) with semantic vector search (for intent). Dual-Optimization: Fine-tuning ranking models that satisfy both human readability and LLM-ready context. High-Stakes Accuracy: In a world of Agents, poor search quality leads to hallucinations. You will build the guardrails and relevance scoring that ensure our AI stays grounded in reality. Data Heterogeneity: Connecting the dots across structured SQL tables, unstructured docs, and real-time business metrics. Why This is the Place to Be You will have a front-row seat to the Agentic revolution. If you want to solve the hardest problems in data discovery and see your work power the decision-making of thousands of people, let’s talk. What We’re Looking For The IR Specialist: You know your way around Lucene/Elasticsearch, embeddings, and ranking algorithms. The Quality and Metrics Obsessive: You understand that "relevance" is subjective and love building evaluation frameworks (human-in-the-loop and LLM-based) to measure it. You are obsessed with relevance metrics (nDCG, MRR, Precision@K). The Bridge Builder: You’re excited to apply traditional Information Retrieval (IR) wisdom to the cutting-edge world of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). title: Skills Systems Architect
text: FEQ227R209 About the Role Databricks needs to understand what technical capability looks like across several large, fast-moving populations: employees, customers, and partners. Today that happens through role-based learning pathways and product-aligned enablement, an approach that can't keep pace with how quickly the platform, technology, and roles change. AI has also collapsed the half-life of technical proficiency, and for the first time, it makes a living, self-maintaining model of capability possible. In this builder role, you'll own systems for defining, measuring, and developing technical capability across Databricks learner audiences. You'll build a capability model that ties roles, skills, content, and credentials together and the instrumentation that shows where capability actually stands. What You'll Own Skills taxonomies, capability models, and learning context Define the skills taxonomies that make up technical capability and shape how they’re organized; what skills exist, which are adjacent, which are prerequisites, how quickly they go stale, and what sources are available to learners for developing and maintaining them. Observability and measurement Stand up instrumentation and AI-informed signals that show where capability stands and where it's drifting. Develop live signals, not a quarterly or monthly health index, to show how skills are moving and evolving. Anticipate where capability demand is heading. Product releases, market shifts, and role evolution are constant; track changes closely so emerging skills surface early and content and programs stay ahead of change. AI-native tooling Build the software that maintains the skills taxonomy and capability model, including LLM-driven skill extraction and organization, agentic pipelines that keep them current, automated drift and gap detection, and APIs that expose it all. Make the model reusable enterprise context that other systems, teams, and products build on vs. a training-only asset. Impact You'll Have You will sit upstream of and across several teams and functions: Anywhere skills show up in products: You define what technical capability means and what evidence counts, so wherever skills are inferred, captured, or recognized, it reflects real technical work and skills & abilities. Content and curriculum. The skills taxonomy and capability model influence what gets built next and why. Learning context is a critical input to generative content. title: Software Engineer - Database Engine Internals
text: P-1414 Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the whole data lifecycle from ingestion to ETL, BI, and all the way up to ML/AI with a unified platform. To achieve this goal, we believe the data warehouse architecture as we know it today will be replaced by a new architectural pattern, Lakehouse ( CIDR 2021 paper ), open platforms that unify data warehousing and advanced analytics. This new architecture will help address several major challenges, including data staleness, reliability, total cost of ownership, data lock-in, and limited use-case support. To achieve this vision, Databricks is building the next generation (decoupled) query engine and structured storage system that can outperform specialized data warehouses in relational query performance. Yet we will retain the expressiveness and robustness of general purpose systems such as Apache Spark™ to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science. You will be part of this multi-year journey. As part of this team, you will design these next-generation systems that leapfrog state-of-the-art within the following areas: Query compilation and optimization Distributed query execution and scheduling Vectorized execution engine Data security Resource management Transaction coordination Efficient storage structures (encodings, indexes) Automatic physical data optimization The responsibilities you will have: Drive requirements clarity and design decisions for ambiguous problems Produce technical design documents and project plans Develop new features Mentor more junior engineers Test and rollout to production, monitoring. title: Software Engineer - New Grad, Distributed Data Systems (2027 Start)
text: P-965 At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions. Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the whole data lifecycle from ingestion to ETL, BI, and all the way up to ML/AI with a unified platform. To achieve this goal, we believe the data warehouse architecture as we know it today will be replaced by a new architectural pattern, Lakehouse ( CIDR 2021 paper ), open platforms that unify data warehousing and advanced analytics. The new architecture will help address several major challenges, including data staleness, reliability, total cost of ownership, data lock-in, and limited use-case support. As part of this team, you could be working in one or more of the following areas: Query compilation and optimization Distributed query execution and scheduling Vectorized execution engine Data security Resource management Transaction coordination Efficient storage structures (encodings, indexes) Automatic physical data optimization Data plane storage Storage management system What we look for: You will graduate in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject You have implementation skills with a general purpose program language, such as Java, or C++ You have knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and OOP principles A passion for database systems, storage systems, distributed systems, language design, or performance optimization You have experience managing end-to-end projects We are hiring Software Engineer - New Grads, Distributed Data Systems across multiple offices.
